Bharati Vidyapeeth (Deemed to be University) Institute of Management and Research (BVIMR), New Delhi, was established in 1992. The institute has been ranked 42nd by IIRF and 61st by The Times of India for its MBA program. The Times of India has also ranked BVIMR 66th for BBA/BMS courses for the year 2025. NAAC accredits BVIMR with an A++ grade.

BVIMR offers Bachelor’s, Master’s, and Doctoral programs in Management, Judiciary, and Computer Sciences. The institute offers MBA as its flagship course. The other courses offered are BBA, BCA, LLB, and PhD. The 1st year BVIMR fee for MBA is INR 3,25,000 and for BBA is INR 1,54,000.

BVIMR Admission is based on, CET(Common Entrance Test) exam conducted by BVDU(Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University), followed by Counselling. Candidates have to log in at @bvducet.bharatividyapeeth for registration. Candidates have to appear for the BMAT(Bharati Vidyapeeth Management Aptitude Test), BV-BUMAT(Bharati Vidyapeeth Undergraduate Management Aptitude Test), and BVBBALAWUG(Bharati Vidyapeeth Law Undergraduate) of CET exams.

As per the available data, the highest package was INR 36 LPA, and the average package was INR 8 LPA in 2024. Over 90 companies visited for BVIMR Placement, including Godrej, EY, KPMG, Wipro, TCS, Gartner, ICICI Prudential, Accenture, FedEx, Protouch, etc.

It has been ranked by IIRF, India Today, and The Times of India in 2024 and 2025 in the Management categories. The details for the BVIMR Ranking are provided below:
BVIMR offers MBA as its flagship course. The details for BVIMR Courses & Fees are mentioned in the table below:
BVIMR offers admission to major courses such as MBA, BBA/BBA(Hons.), BCA/BCA(Hons.), BBALLB, LLB, and PhD. BVIMR Admission is based on entrance exams, followed by Counselling or PI.

Admission to MBA based on BMAT, followed by Counselling. Meanwhile, admission to BBA/BBA(Hons.) and BCA/BCA(Hons.) is based on BV-BUMAT, followed by Counselling. Admission to BBALLB and LLB is based on BV-BBA-LAW-UG. Admission to PhD courses is based on UGC-NET, followed by a Personal Interview.

BVIMR is a residential college with only girls' hostels on campus. The institute has multiple facilities such as an information centre, a seminar hall, an auditorium, a music room, a sports ground, a gym, a medical centre, an indoor sports activities centre, libraries, and canteens.

The following YouTube video shows the campus of BVIMR. The video features an inside tour of the campus, beginning with the seminar hall and proceeding to the canteens. The campus has high-tech, ultra-modern computers, editing studios, training rooms, radio rooms, and classrooms. The video also shows the Media Centre where all the training takes place. The BVIMR campus features an amphitheatre, an open-air canteen, and hostels.
Ques. What is the duration of the BCA course at BVIMR?

Ans. The BCA course at BVIMR has a duration of 3 years for the regular BCA program and 4 years for the BCA (hons.) program. The 3-year BCA program is divided into six semesters, while the Honors program has eight semesters over 4 years.
Ques. Does BVIMR provide hostel accommodation?

Ans. BVIMR provides hostel accommodation only for female students. The college has 2 girls’ hostel buildings within the campus, accommodating around 100 girls. These hostels offer facilities like internet connections, recreation centres, comfortable dining halls, indoor games, newspapers, magazines, an intercom, and cable TV. The rooms are air-conditioned with attached bathrooms, study tables, and other required furniture. The hostels are well-maintained, hygienic, and have 24/7 mess services offering healthy food at affordable prices. There is no hostel facility for boys, who need to find accommodation outside the campus.
Ques. Does BVIMR offer scholarships?

Ans. BVIMR does not directly offer its scholarships. However, students at BVIMR are eligible to apply for various scholarships provided by BVIMR Deemed to be University and other government or private scholarship schemes.

Ques. Does a candidate have to clear CAT for MBA at BVIMR?

Ans. No, a candidate does not have to clear the CAT exam for admission to the MBA program at BVIMR. Instead, BVIMR conducts its entrance exam called BMAT, followed by counselling and Personal Interview rounds conducted by the university.
The candidate must clear the BMAT entrance exam and should have a bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks.

Institute of Engineering and Management (IEM Kolkata) was established in 1989 and is a private engineering and management institute affiliated with MAKAUT. The first campus was in Salt Lake, Sector V. The institute is approved by AICTE and accredited by NBA and NAAC with ‘A’ grade. In 2025, IEM was ranked 221st (B.Tech) and 173rd (Computer Applications) by CollegeDunia, and placed in the 151–200 band (B.Tech) by NIRF.
Note: From 2026, the institute will not consider WBJEE for admission to its B.Tech. programs.

Placement: IEM Kolkata has not published the placement details of 2025, but from students' reviews and research, the highest salary offered was INR 32 LPA for B.Tech. students. IEM NIRF Report 2026 states that the median package is around INR 6 LPA for B.Tech and INR 3.36 LPA for M.Tech, while the MBA median package is about INR 17 LPA.
Students can find the IEM Kolkata NIRF Report 2026 here.

Some of the top recruiters at the Institute of Engineering and Management Kolkata include Amazon, Tata Consultancy Services, Capgemini, Wipro, Cognizant, Infosys, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, Ernst & Young, IBM, HCL Technologies, Tech Mahindra, Larsen & Toubro, and ITC Limited.

IEM Kolkata has many useful facilities for students. There are separate hostels and common rooms for boys and girls. The campus has a medical unit for free health check-ups and vaccinations, and every student gets a Mediclaim policy worth INR 50,000. It also provides bus services.

Each department has its own lab. There are special labs like AI+ML Lab, AR-VR Lab, and Data Science Lab. The digital library is open all day, all year, with thousands of books, journals, and access to websites like IEEE and J-GATE. The campus has free Wi-Fi and an AC Canteen. It also has sports rooms and areas for games like cricket, football, table tennis, and chess.
IEM Sports Facilities

According to Subhrodip Pal’s review on CollegeDunia, Institute of Engineering and Management Kolkata offers decent infrastructure, disciplined campus life, and good academic facilities, though the campus environment is quite strict and academically demanding.

The student mentions that the total B.Tech course fees are around INR 8,50,000 with scholarships like SVMCM available. The campus hosts events such as INNO FUSION, hackathons, and student clubs, but sports facilities and open spaces are limited due to the relatively small campus size. Classrooms follow a traditional setup with projectors and mic facilities, and the library provides adequate academic resources.

IEM Kolkata provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls, located close to the main academic campus. The hostels offer a range of options; Non-AC and AC rooms, typically with double or triple occupancy. Annual fees for Non-AC rooms are approximately INR 1 lakh to INR 1.05 lakhs, while for AC rooms is approximately INR 1.66 lakhs, depending on amenities. The hostels are furnished with basic bedding, Wi-Fi connectivity, and access to a mess that serves three meals daily. Safety features include 24/7 security, CCTV surveillance, and resident wardens to ensure student welfare.

IEM Kolkata is a top private institute known for its strong academics, consistent placements, and great ROI. It offers a median package of INR 6 LPA for B.Tech and an impressive INR 16.4 LPA for MBA, with top recruiters like Amazon, TCS, Capgemini, Infosys, and Wipro. With fees around INR 8 lakhs to INR 8.65 lakhs and scholarships up to 100%, IEM Kolkata provides a competitive ROI for meritorious students. If you’re unable to secure admission into top-tier national institutes like IITs, NITs, or top private universities such as VIT or SRM, IEM Kolkata is a strong alternative.
Ques. Is IEM Kolkata good for B.Tech CSE?

Ans. Yes, IEM Kolkata is a good choice for B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE). With total fees of about INR 8.65 lakhs and various merit-based scholarships (up to 100%), the ROI is strong. The median package for B.Tech stands at around INR 6 LPA, with top recruiters such as Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, and Wipro hiring regularly from the campus.
Ques. Is it worth studying for an MBA from IEM Kolkata?

Ans. Yes, pursuing an MBA from IEM Kolkata is a good choice for students who are looking for a good, placement focused B-school without paying high fees. The institute has a strong record of placements and ROI, with a median package of INR 16.4 LPA and a ROI of 50% in 2024 and top recruiters including Amazon, TCS, EY, Capgemini, Axis Bank, and more.
Ques. Can a student get admission to IEM Kolkata through WBJEE?

Ans. No, students cannot get admission to IEM Kolkata through WBJEE anymore. The institute has discontinued admissions via WBJEE from the current academic year. Earlier, IEM Kolkata accepted candidates based on WBJEE and JEE Main scores, but now all B.Tech admissions are conducted solely through IEMJEE, the institute’s own entrance examination and counselling process.
Ques. Can I apply to IEM Kolkata through IEMJEE or IEMCET, and who is eligible for these exams?

Ans. Yes. For admission to B.Tech or B. Tech (Lateral Entry) at the Institute of Engineering and Management, students can appear for the IEMJEE. If you are applying for other programs like BBA, BCA, BHM, BBA LLB, MCA, or M.Tech, you need to take the IEMCET conducted by the institute. Both exams are used by IEM to shortlist candidates for counselling and admission.
Ques. Is the IEMJEE as tough as the JEE Main?

Ans. IEMJEE is not as tough as JEE Main. While both exams share a similar syllabus based on the Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics topics from Classes 11 and 12, the difficulty level and competition are quite different. Given below is a comparison between IEMJEE and JEE Main:

MCA at IEM Kolkata is a 2-year, full-time, degree program offered On Campus.

First, ensure you meet eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths from a recognised board. Then, apply online for the institute’s entrance exam, IEMJEE, through the official website. After appearing and qualifying in IEMJEE, participate in the counselling for seat allocation based on entrance score and preferences. Finally, complete document verification and fee payment as notified by the institute to confirm your admission.

IEM Kolkata reserves around 25% of B.Tech seats for Management Quota, allowing admission based on Class 12 PCM marks without requiring JEE Main, WBJEE, or IEMJEE scores. Candidates must meet the eligibility criteria and pay higher fees for direct admission under this quota

Admission to the Institute of Engineering and Management, Kolkata, is entrance-based. For B.Tech, candidates must qualify WBJEE or IEMJEE and meet 12th PCM criteria. Apply online, attend counselling, verify documents, and pay fees to confirm admission. Final admission is granted after completing all formalities and document submission.

IEM Kolkata BBA is offered as 3 Years Full Time program, with total intake of 120 seats. The minimum eligibility criteria for BBA is 10+2 with 50%. The total fees for IEM Kolkata BBA is INR 3.35 Lakhs for the complete course duration. IEM Kolkata Hostel Fee is INR 1.05 Lakhs.

IEM Kolkata B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering is offered as 4 Years Full Time program. The minimum eligibility criteria for B.Tech is 10+2 with 60%+WBJEE. The total fees for IEM Kolkata B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering is INR 8.67 Lakhs for the complete course duration

IEM Kolkata offers admission to BTech, MBA, BCA, BBA, BTech (Lateral), and MCA programs. IEM Kolkata Admission is based on WBJEE, JEE Main, IEM JEE, JEMAT, CAT, MAT, WBJELET, WB JECA, GATE and Common Entrance Test (CET) conducted by MAKAUT. Candidates have to register at wbjeeb.nic.in/wbjee for BTech admissions. For MBA admissions, candidates can apply through the official website: cetmat.formflix.com/jemat.

IEM Kolkata offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs. Which lead to two primary degrees: B.Tech and M.Tech. IEM Kolkata offers B.Tech program in 11 different specialisations. Candidates seeking admission to the BTech program at IEM Kolkata must have valid score in the WBJEE/ IEMJEE/ JEE Mains and the seat allocation process will be done through the respective counselling.

IEM Kolkata also offers BCA, BBA, and MSc (Computer Science) through the Common Entrance Test (CET) conducted by MAKAUT. Students can also choose to opt for the MBA program offered by this institute for 2 years. To be eligible for this program, candidates have to qualify for the CAT/ JEMAT exams, followed by a PI and GD round. Alongside, IEM Kolkata also offers admission to the MCA and MTech programs at the PG levels. The institute accepts WBJECA and GATE scores, respectively, to allow admission to these programs.

subjects: To take part in the counseling process for admission to the B.Tech courses, a candidate must have passed the 10+2 examination and possess a valid score in WBJEE or JEE Main. The candidates will be allocated a seat based on their entrance examination scores.

80% seats will be filled by WBJEE candidates, 10% of the seats will be filled by JEE Main candidates, and the rest of the seats will be filled through management quota. For candidates with a Diploma in engineering, there’s also a provision of lateral entry in the 2nd year via the JELET examination.
To take admission in the M.Tech programs, a candidate must have a B.E./ B.Tech or equivalent degree in the relevant discipline and must have a valid score in WBUT PGET/ GATE examination.
To take admission to the MBA program, a candidate must be a graduate in any discipline with a valid score in MAT/ JEMAT.

Narula Institute of Technology, Kolkata, Haldia Institute of Technology, Kolkata, and Techno India University offer similar 4-year B.Tech programs with comparable course structure and eligibility. Narula has the highest fees (INR 809000) but also delivers the strongest ROI with the highest average salary (INR 625000). Haldia Institute of Technology is the most affordable (INR 582700) and offers a good ROI with a decent average salary (INR 500000), making it a cost-effective choice. Fairfield Institute of Management and Technology (FIMT), established in 2008, is a private college that is associated with GGSIPU, Delhi. It is approved by BCI & NCTE and is accredited by NAAC. It is ranked 37 in India in the BBA/BMS category, according to the Times of India in 2025. It offers admission to various UG and PG courses in law, business administration, journalism, commerce, computer applications, and education.

Fairfield Institute of Management and Technology offers a BCA as its flagship program. FIMT BCA 2025 fee for the first year is INR 81,500. Admission is based on the eligibility criteria that the candidate must have qualified for 10+2 and should possess a valid score in the IPU CET entrance exams conducted by GGSIPU.

Fairfield Institute of Management and Technology offers non-governmental scholarships. Internal merit-based scholarships for highly meritorious students, special concessions to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) students with marks above 60%, and financial assistance funded by private organizations such as the Shree Maheshwari Foundation are available. Financial assistance of up to INR 5,000 per semester, depending upon academic performance and financial requirements, can be awarded to eligible students.

Fairfield Institute of Management and Technology's Entrepreneurship Cell 2025 offers a mix of training programs, guest talks, and mentorship to mentor aspiring entrepreneurs from conceptualization to implementation. The review by Vedant Chawla, who is a BBA + LLB student of the 2024 batch at Fairfield Institute of Management and Technology (FIMT), provides a real and unapologetic overview of life for students at the college. Vedant likes the fact that the campus is close to his home, providing an added convenience factor. He points to the reasonable fee pattern, helpful faculty, and neat infrastructure facilities such as parking facilities as chief positives of his stint at FIMT.

He also mentions that the law syllabus is student-oriented, incorporating moot court rooms and legal competitions that facilitate the practical application of theory. Vedant mentions that exams are neither very easy nor very tough, and hence academic stress becomes easy to handle. He also likes the internship that comes with cooperation from renowned advocates and legal firms. He states that students are mostly paid stipends between INR 15,000 and INR 40,000, and such internships give real courtroom experience, which is particularly beneficial for law students.

On the other hand, Vedant mentions some disadvantages. He is of the opinion that the campus is quite small and that the neighborhood, as part of an industrial area, perhaps is not the most attractive for students in search of energetic or picturesque surroundings. Nevertheless, his general review demonstrates contentment with the college's services and the value it provides to would-be law professionals.

Ques. How does FIMT support first-year students in adjusting to college life?

Ans. FIMT conducts an organized orientation week at the start of each academic year in which new students are familiarized with faculty members, department coordinators, clubs, and institutional facilities. Newcomers are also mentored by peer mentors and senior students, particularly from out of town. Orientation workshops on communication skills, essential IT tools, and academic protocol are conducted to ease the entry of students into college habits. Mentorship is carried forward throughout the semester through faculty advisors and student support services.
Ques. Does FIMT provide specializations in B.Tech AI & ML other than ordinary CS subjects?

Ans. Yes, FIMT's B.Tech in AI & ML combines foundational CS courses with advanced modules on machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, and AI frameworks based on Python. Industry advisors have helped design the curriculum, which comprises lab-based projects and electives from up-and-coming tech areas.
Ques. How are media students assessed for practical skills at FIMT?

Ans. The BA (JMC) students are graded through live reporting exercises, short-film/documentary assignments, scriptwriting exercises, and field interviews. The students are exposed to camera packages and video editing software, and their productions are evaluated not only on content, but also on imagination, technical quality, and storytelling. Their projects are usually screened at media events or posted on department-operated social sites, providing them with an actual audience and portfolio-ready material.
Ques. Are FIMT students exposed to actual courtrooms or industry locations?

Ans. Yes, FIMT law students are taken for Delhi High Court visits, Supreme Court observation, and legal aid camps. Management and BCA students visit corporate offices, startup incubators, and IT companies for industry training. Journalism students receive media studio tours and press event exposures. These visits are part of an organized experiential learning strategy and are frequently linked to credit-based assignments or reports.

Indian Institute of Business Management Patna (IIBM Patna). It is a private institution established in 1979, located in Budh Marg, Patna, Bihar. The institution is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, New Delhi, for MBA, and Aryabhatta Knowledge University for BBA and BCA. IIBM Patna is primarily a management and business institution and, therefore, offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma courses that are BBA, MBA, and PGDM.

Ques. What are the programmes offered at IIBM Patna, and which are the most popular?

Ans. IIBM Patna offers multiple programmes, including PGDM, MBA, BBA, BCA, and B.Voc. The PGDM and MBA programs are the most preferred programs. They are known for their industry-relevant curriculum and placement opportunities.
Ques. What is the admission process and eligibility for PGDM at IIBM Patna?

Ans. For admission to IIBM Patna's PGDM programme, a graduation degree is required with a minimum of 50% marks and a valid CAT, MAT, XAT, or CMAT score. After the shortlisting process, students will undergo group discussions and personal interviews.
Ques. How does IIBM Patna assist students with placements and internships?

Ans. IIBM Patna has its own placement cell, which organizes placements through reputed companies like Genpact, Accenture, IBM, KPMG, etc. Most students get placements at IIBM Patna (60-70%) every year, and most students (80-90%) get internships, which provide important exposure to the industry.
Ques. What is the average salary package and the highest salary package for IIBM Patna students?
Ans. The highest package in 2024-25 was INR 11.25 LPA, while the average package was INR 7 LPA, and the lowest package was INR 3.5 lakh.
Ques. What are the challenges faced by students at IIBM Patna?

Ans. Some students have stated that there is limited industry exposure due to regional constraints, there is a slightly congested campus, and there are limitations on infrastructure. Students noted that placement is competitive, and only some students obtain top placements.
Ques. What is the faculty like and the teaching quality at IIBM Patna?

Ans. Faculty at IIBM Patna are at a generally well-disposed level, and the overall student confidence level is high. Many students have stated they appreciate the case study-based teaching model and doubt-clearing sessions. The students have stated they wish there were some more practical learning and industry interaction.
Ques. Does IIBM Patna offer any scholarships or financial help to students?

Ans. Yes, IIBM Patna offers both merit-based and need-based scholarships. It also offers scholarship opportunities for students from reserved categories and the economically weaker sections, according to the government scholarship eligibility.
Ques. What are the campus facilities and campus student life at IIBM Patna?

Ans. Facilities at IIBM Patna include smart classrooms, computer labs, a central library, a computer lab with wifi, and a student activity center. There is hostel accommodation, however limited. Students have stated that even if the campus was limited in facilities, IIBM Patna provides a friendly approach to learning with interaction and collaboration.

It is recognised by UGC and accredited with an A++ grade by NAAC and NBA

The university ranks 129th in India and 5th in Odisha under the Collegedunia B.Tech ranking 2025. SOA also ranks 22nd in India and 2nd in Odisha for its B.Tech program by NIRF (2025). So, I embarked on my journey! I had no clear idea of where I was headed. I found myself enjoying the production engineering aspects of biotechnology. Deep down, I felt like a mechanical engineering guy wanting to be the tough guy, rather than someone in a white coat peering through a microscope. I worked hard to secure a project in a relevant area.

Both Adamas University Kolkata and SOA University offer solid BALLB Hons. programs, but Adamas seems to have a slight edge in terms of placements and internships. However, if you're prioritizing a specific area of law or have personal connections to SOA, that could sway your decision.

Yes, many people in India may advise against pursuing a career in biotechnology. It's a tough reality that the biotechnology job market in India is quite competitive. However, if you have a passion for biology or biotechnology, don't let that deter you!

In countries like Canada and the USA, the healthcare sector is thriving, creating opportunities for innovation. In these developed nations, such programs are offered to the most talented individuals. So, while biotechnology may not be the top choice in India, it's still a valuable field where you can tackle real-life problems.
Despite the challenges, this sector is growing rapidly in India, and in a few years, there’s a strong possibility that India could emerge as a leading biotech hub.
Stay positive! You have the power to make a difference, and you will make that change.
All the best for your future! :)

Adamas University Kolkata seems to have a solid advantage when it comes to placements and internships for B.Pharm students compared to SOA University. The compassionate teachers at Adamas are a big plus, and the annual fest offers networking opportunities that can be beneficial for job prospects. On the other hand, SOA University has a structured curriculum but provides limited scholarship options, which might affect students financially. If you're looking for a supportive environment with better placement prospects, Adamas University Kolkata might be the better choice, while SOA University could be suitable if you prefer a more traditional academic approach.

Adamas University Kolkata's B.Tech in Biotechnology has a higher fee structure at around Rs.85,000 per semester, which can be a financial burden, but they do offer some scholarships and a decent placement rate, with over 90% of students getting jobs by their 7th semester. In contrast, SOA University's B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning seems to provide a more tech-focused curriculum with a moderate fee structure and also offers scholarships, but the details on placements are less clear. If you're leaning towards tech and AI, SOA might be a smarter financial choice in the long run due to the growing job market in that field.

However, if you have a passion for both biology and technology and are willing to invest more, Adamas could be worth it for the strong faculty and internship opportunities. Ultimately, go for SOA if you want a better ROI in a rapidly evolving domain.

In terms of placements and career outcomes, Adamas University Kolkata's BALLB Hons. program seems to have an edge due to its supportive faculty and dedicated law library, which can enhance students' learning and opportunities. The university has a good reputation in West Bengal, which aids in attracting internships and job placements. While SOA University also offers a solid curriculum and campus life, its comparatively higher fees and limited scholarship options might deter some students from focusing on placements. Therefore, Adamas University is a better choice for those looking for a more well-rounded law education with potential for better job prospects, while SOA University could suit students who prioritize a diverse campus life and are willing to invest more financially.

Adamas University Kolkata's B.Tech in Biotechnology offers a unique blend of biology and tech, with a faculty that has impressive qualifications, making it ideal for those who want to delve into research and innovation. The campus life is vibrant with various clubs and tech fests, but the higher fees and fewer internship opportunities can be drawbacks. On the other hand, SOA University's B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering has a well-structured curriculum with good faculty support and a strong focus on placements, boasting over 90% success for those who apply. If you’re more inclined towards electronics and immediate job prospects, SOA might be the better choice, while Adamas suits those passionate about biotech research. Personally, I’d lean towards SOA University for its placement opportunities and practical focus, especially if I aim to enter the workforce directly after graduation.

Adamas University Kolkata offers a solid B.Pharm program with good placement percentages around 80%, making it a decent option for job seekers. However, SOA University claims 100% placement, which is impressive, especially with a similar fee structure of around Rs.6,80,000 to Rs.9,00,000. Adamas has more scholarship opportunities, which might help reduce the overall cost, but SOA's higher placement success could lead to a better return on investment. If you prioritize job placements and can manage the fees, SOA University might be the smarter financial choice, while Adamas offers good value if you need more financial support through scholarships.

Adamas University Kolkata's B.Tech in Biotechnology and SOA University's B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning both offer unique advantages, but they differ significantly in terms of fees and return on investment. Adamas has a higher fee structure, with around 85,000 per semester, but boasts a strong placement record where over 90% of eligible students secure jobs, making it a solid investment for those pursuing biotechnology.

In contrast, while SOA's AI and ML program is also promising, details on placements are less compelling and the program appears to be more focused on research, which may not translate as effectively into immediate job opportunities. The college organizes annual cultural and technical fests, usually held around February–March, where students actively participate in events, competitions, and performances, making campus life more engaging. There are various student clubs and groups that focus on technical skills, cultural activities, and personality development, which help students improve their confidence and social connections.

A.G. Group of Institutions is a Bokaro-based institution that was founded in 2020. The institution is approved by the INC, and affiliated with Binod Bihari Mahto Koyalanchal.

A.G. Group of Institutions offers multiple programs among which BSc Nursing is most preferred. It is governed by Abdul Gafur Ansari Educational Trust and admission to its programs is granted on a merit basis.

A.G. Group of Institutions offers a full-time and 4-year duration B.Sc Nursing course at the UG level, a 2-year M.Sc Nursing, and Post Basic B.Sc Nursing at the PG level. subjects: Academic Infrastructure: The institute has well-equipped classrooms and computer laboratories.

Library: Biyani Girls College offers access to an extensive collection of over 1.1 Lakhs books, journals & magazines. It also has a digital library, like the ICSI Study Centre, and a DELNET membership.

OORJA (Gym): The campus prioritises daily holistic well-being of students, where students can reduce stress, enhance mood, and overall boost themselves.
Transportation: It provides hustle-free transportation facilities to its students to focus on their academics.
Pedagogy Rooms: The institute has music and dance rooms, where students can enjoy creative collaboration, expression, dance rehearsals, classes, and performances.

Auditorium and seminar Facilities: The campus has an air-conditioned auditorium named Ustav, with a large seating capacity to conduct seminars, workshops, conferences, and guest lectures. It allows students to interact with legal professionals and judges, and provides valuable exposure.

Biyani Girls College, Jaipur, is a private institute in Jaipur, Rajasthan, established in 2005. The institution is accredited by NAAC with an A grade and affiliated with Rajasthan University. Some programs, such as B.Sc, BBA, B.Com, BA, and BCA, are among the popular courses at Biyani Girls College.

Biyani Girls College offers a 3-year B.Sc program in Biotechnology as the most popular course, with a total fee of INR 2.55 Lakhs for the entire duration. Given below are the details for Biyani Girls College Courses and Fees:

Admission to the Biyani Girls College is based on merit in 10+2 and graduation with a minimum required mark, depending on the program. Biyani Girls College offers B.Sc in 3 specialisations, including Biotechnology, Biology, and Mathematics. Students can check the admission criteria for Biyani Girls College Admission:

Biyani Girls College offers the Kalpana Chawla Scholarship for students enrolled in BA, B.Sc, BBA, BCA, and BVA programs. Currently, no scholarships are provided for MA and MSc courses; however, M.Com students preparing for CA/CS examinations are eligible for scholarship support.

Students interested in admission to Biyani Girls College, Jaipur, can enrol themselves through both on-campus and online modes. The general admission process is as follows:
Some facilities available to students at Biyani Girls College are-

Biyani Girls College provides a hostel to both male and female students. The rooms are well ventilated, furnished with wooden tables, chairs, beds, and wardrobes. It also provides options for four/six-bedded air-cooled rooms with attached toilets and bathrooms, with a hostel fee of INR 1.20 Lakhs. Biyani Girls College Hostel facilities for hostellers include 24X7 conveyance facility, elevator, water purifier, counseling room, laundry, housekeeping, and more.
Ques. Can a student get direct admission to Biyani Girls College?

Ans. Yes, students can apply for admission directly through the college’s application process based on eligibility criteria. However, for some courses like B.Ed/M. Ed admission is strictly based on Rajasthan PTET and MPET.
Ques. Does Biyani Girls College offer scholarships to students?

Ans. Yes, Biyani Girls College offers the Kalpana Chawla Scholarship for students enrolled in BA, B.Sc, BBA, BCA, and BVA programs. Currently, no scholarships are provided for MA and MSc courses; however, M.Com students preparing for CA/CS examinations are eligible for scholarship support.
Ques. Does Biyani Girls College offer management quota admission?

Ans. As per research, Biyani Girls College does not offer admission to its programs based on management quota. Admissions are primarily based on candidates fulfilling the required eligibility criteria.
Ques. Can students from other states apply to Biyani Girls College?

Ans. Yes, students from any state can apply to Biyani College, provided they meet the basic minimum eligibility criteria, i.e., passed 10+2 or graduation with a minimum of required marks from a recognised board or university or equivalent.

rows: What do students have to say about the DAV College Chandigarh admission?

As per Chaitanya Soni, a student of B.Com (General) at DAVC, DAV College Chandigarh is regarded as a top B.Com institute under Panjab University, offering solid academic grounding and vibrant campus life with diverse extracurriculars. The BCom course provides foundational business knowledge and opens pathways for careers in finance, accounting, and business, though practical exposure like industrial visits and internships is limited. The class size is about 70, with annual fees close to ₹33,000, and various scholarships are available. Placements occur from the 5th semester, primarily in BPO and sales roles, with companies like Sri Ram Insurance, Planet Spark, and Zomato visiting; the highest packages reach 5 LPA, and the average is about 1.5 LPA. The faculty is supportive and experienced, and the campus offers excellent infrastructure and cultural diversity, making it a good choice for studies and student life. Read More

Ques. Is PSIT Kanpur a Tier 2 or Tier 3 college?

Ans. PSIT Kanpur is generally considered a Tier 2–Tier 3 private engineering college affiliated with AKTU. It is known for strong placements, with the highest package reaching INR 66 LPA and a UG median salary of INR 5.23 LPA, making it a good ROI option among private institutes in Uttar Pradesh.
Ques. What is the dress code at PSIT Kanpur?

Ans. PSIT follows a strict formal dress code for all students. Boys are required to wear formal shirts, trousers, and shoes, while girls must wear formal or professional attire. Carrying an ID card is mandatory, and the institute emphasizes discipline and professionalism on campus.
Ques. What is student life like at PSIT Kanpur?

Ans. Student life at PSIT is academics and placement-focused, with modern classrooms, advanced labs, a central library, hostels, sports grounds, a cafeteria, and transport facilities. The college also conducts technical fests, seminars, workshops, and cultural events, offering a structured and disciplined campus environment.
Ques. What is the lowest package at PSIT Kanpur?

Ques. Does PSIT Kanpur provide hostel facilities?

Ans. Yes, PSIT Kanpur provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls within the campus. Hostels include furnished rooms, Wi-Fi, mess facilities, 24/7 security, wardens, and recreational spaces to ensure a safe and comfortable stay for outstation students.
Ques. What is the fee structure of PSIT Kanpur?

Ans. The tuition fee is approximately INR 1.09 Lakhs per year for major programs. The total B.Tech fee is around INR 4.37 Lakhs for 4 years, while MBA, MCA, and M.Tech programs cost about INR 2.19 Lakhs for 2 years. BBA and BCA programs cost around INR 3.28 Lakhs for 3 years.

Ques. Is Bishop Heber College Recognized and Accredited?

Ans. Yes. Bishop Heber College is well recognized by the University Grants Commission. It has also been awarded with an A++ grade from the National Assessment and Accreditation Council, which is the highest grade given to an institution in the country. This accreditation displays the college’s enduring academic achievement, rich culture in research, outstanding faculty, comprehensive curriculum, and student-oriented facilities. The A++ accreditation is an indication of BHC's continued commitment to teaching, research, and community engagement at an international level, establishing it as one of the top colleges in South India.
Ques. What type of courses does Bishop Heber College offer?

Ans. Bishop Heber College has various comprehensive academic programs to suit students from different backgrounds. The college has Undergraduate, Postgraduate, M.Phil, and PHD programs in Arts, Science, Commerce and Management. Traditional undergraduate programs offered at the institution include B.A, B.Sc, B.Com, and professional programs of BBA and BCA. Students at the postgraduate level are offered advanced courses in English, History, Physics, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Computer Science, and Management among other specializations.
Ques. What is the affiliation of Bishop Heber College?

Ans. Bishop Heber College is an autonomous institution affiliated with Bharathidasan University, Tiruchirappalli. The autonomous status provides the college with academic freedom to design its curriculum, adopt innovative teaching methodologies, conduct examinations, and evaluate students independently. However, the degrees are awarded by Bharathidasan University, ensuring that the programs remain in line with the university’s standards. This dual advantage of autonomy and affiliation helps BHC maintain flexibility in curriculum design while ensuring credibility and recognition of its courses both nationally and internationally.
Ques. Does Bishop Heber College provide hostel facilities?

Ans. Yes, Bishop Heber College provides well-maintained hostel facilities for both boys and girls within the campus premises. The hostels are designed to create a safe and supportive living environment for students who come from different parts of India and abroad. Each hostel is equipped with essential amenities such as a dining hall, study rooms, internet and Wi-Fi connectivity, and 24/7 security arrangements. The hostels also have recreational spaces to promote a balanced lifestyle among students. With dedicated wardens and staff, the hostels ensure discipline, comfort, and a homely atmosphere, thereby helping students focus on academics while enjoying a healthy campus life.

The college is equipped with well furnished classrooms with audio-visual aids, a central library containing an extensive collection of books, journals, as well as digital resources, and well-equipped practical laboratories for science and technology. In addition the campus has well equipped computer centres, seminar halls, and an auditorium for academic and cultural events. The college infrastructure includes a cafeteria, a medical centre, and a study hall with a medical centre which satisfies unmet student demand. Apart from academics, BHC equally focuses on Physical Education by having proper arrangements for an extensive range of sports and indoor-outdoor games with gymnasiums and playgrounds. Such arrangements bring a positive change to the students by making them more versatile.

Bishop Heber College has 6 girls’ hostels. Four of the hostels are inside the college campus. Two of the hostels are reserved for PG students. First-year UG students are mostly allocated to BSD or MA hostels. 6 students are allocated to each room. Mobiles phones are prohibited inside the campus. But students use it secretly. You can only use laptops with the permission of the principal.
The hostel rooms don’t have any attached restrooms. You will have to clear your rooms as well as the restrooms.
Food offered at the mess is average at best. There is no shop or canteen on campus. Students are only allowed to go out on Sundays for four hours.

There is no such cutoff for B.Sc Actuarial Science in Bishop Heber College. If you are from the Tamil Nadu State Board and have decent marks, you should get admission. But try to submit your application on the day of your 12th results. The aided seats get filled first. Most students that apply on result day get admission except for a few cases.

For undergraduate courses, it's better to get your application form before your +2 results. Because by the time result is out, most of the seats in the aided section will be filled. So, as soon as your result is declared go to the respective department admission team and submit your application. If you are eligible, you will get admission.
For postgraduation courses, admission starts around June. So, after your final semester, check the admission date in the respective departments.

I have a few friends who graduated from Bishop Heber College. Besides academics, this college teaches you about all aspects of life. During your college days at Bishop Heber, you will get to learn about responsibilities along with freedom. It also gives you opportunities to explore your hidden talents and hobbies.

Yes, using mobile in the hostel is prohibited at Bishop Heber College. But most students use it secretly. The wardens of boys hostel don’t really mind is students are using mobiles. Rules in girl's hostels are comparably strict.
If you get caught using mobile, you will have to pay a fine of INR 1,000 and write an apology letter. If you have written 3 apology letters, you will have to leave the hostel.

The placement at Bishop Heber College is average at best. At the beginning of your final year, there will be an orientation program on what is next. They will give you a choice whether to go for higher studies or placements. Companies like TCS, Infosys, CTS etc. come for placements. The placement training division trains students for each company interview based on the specific requirements. To appear for the placement drive, you need to have at least 75% marks. You are not allowed to participate further if you get selected in 2 companies.

Bishop Heber College has two sections, i.e. aided and self-finance. The faculties for the aided section are pretty good compared to the self-finance section. The faculties from the self-finance section lack experience. The infrastructure of the college is decent. K.A.P Vishwanathan Block is for arts and science department. Bishop Solomon doraiswamy block is for computer science students and other departments. It has a good library with large stock of books as well as a book bank.
There are four hostels for boys and girls each. Food provided is average at best. 8 people are allotted to each room.
You won’t find a decent wi-fi connection on campus. Use of mobile phones is prohibited though many use it secretly.

17 May, 2026 TS EAMCET 2026 Result is out. Candidates can download their rank cards online @eapcet.tgche.ac.in. Read News!

Rishi M.S. Institute of Engineering & Technology (RITW) is a private institute established in 2009. It is located in Hyderabad, Telangana. The institute is affiliated with JNTU Hyderabad and is accredited by AICTE.
RITW offers a UG course and has an intake capacity of 300. Its flagship course is B.Tech, and the first-year fees are INR 54,000. Admissions are based on EAMCET.

The RITW campus placement batch of 2023 students has grabbed 82 offer letters. The highest package offered is INR 7.25 LPA; the average package offered is INR 6.42 LPA, and the lowest package offered is INR 4.50 LPA. The companies that have placed the students are TCS, Ubergrad, SBI Card, Hike Edu Pvt Ltd, Intellipaat, ILensys, Unschool, and many more.
Here are the key highlights of RITW:

RITW has 4 departments: CSE, IT, ECE, and H&S. The admission process is both online and offline. At least 70% of the seats are allotted by the convener, EAMCET. In this 70%, all the seats are at a uniform fee. The remaining 30% are filled by the management of the college, and overall, 85% of the seats are reserved for local candidates. Also, 10% of the total intake is for lateral entry, and the seats are filled based on ECET rank. Candidates can click here for the admission form.

The RITW cutoff for 2025 has not been released yet. However, the EAMCET cutoff 2024 for the General Category is listed below. The overall cutoff rank for EAMCET is 82271-109405
Tabulated below are the details of category-wise EAMCET cutoff 2024:

The RITW campus placement batch of 2023 has received the highest package of INR 7.25 LPA, the average package offered is INR 6.42 LPA, and the lowest package offered is INR 4.50 LPA. The companies that have placed the students are TCS, Ubergrad, SBI Card, HikeEdu Pvt. Ltd., Intellipaat, ILensys, Unschool, and many more.

RITW scholarships are available for SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority, and disabled students based on income and location. Income should be INR 1 lakh to INR 2.5 lakhs annually. Students must maintain 75% attendance and promotion for renewal. Hostel students get INR 1,500, and day scholars get INR 650 as maintenance/mess charges.

RITW is spread over 5.2 acres of land. The classrooms are well-furnished and equipped with computers. The campus has an open auditorium, a canteen, a special room for women, and first aid facilities. The college has a digital library available to the students and faculty. For e-journals and e-books, students can visit https://ndigitalonline.com. At present, the library has 2,725 titles and 11,525 volumes. RITW also provides both indoor and outdoor facilities such as carrom, Chess, badminton, Kabaddi, Kho kho, Tug of war, athletics, throwball, Yoga, and Cricket.
RITW does not have hostel facilities on the campus.
Ques: What is the address of RITW?
Ans: The address of RITW is near JNTUH, Nizampet Cross Road, Kukatpally, Hyderabad - 500085, Telangana, India.
Ques: What does the Humanities & Sciences department comprise at RITW?
Ans: At RITW, the department of Humanities & Sciences comprises seven disciplines, namely, English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Environmental Sciences, Physical Education, and Library Sciences.
Ques: Does RITW provide lateral entry for the B.Tech course?
Ans: Candidates having diplomas in engineering and technology can apply for the B.Tech course directly for the second year with lateral entry at the RITW.

United Institute of Technology (UIT), Allahabad, is a private engineering college situated in Prayagraj (formerly Allahabad), in Uttar Pradesh. The institute was founded in 2007 as part of the United Group of Institutions. UIT is affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, accredited by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and UGC. It offers UG and PG programs in various engineering and technology disciplines.

The United Institute of Technology (UIT), Allahabad, B.Tech degree is the flagship program, with an annual tuition of about INR 1.2 lakh. To apply for admission to this program, students must have passed 10+2 in English, Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics subjects and qualify through JEE Main or UPTAC (Uttar Pradesh State Entrance Exam) counseling.

United Institute of Technology (UIT), Allahabad, placement data for 2025 is not yet published, but the 2024 placements show that about 70% of the eligible students were placed. The highest salary package was INR 9.8 LPA, while the average package stood at INR 5.6 LPA. About 80-90% of the students received an internship offer. The major recruiters were Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, Cognizant, and TechMahindra.
Here are the key highlights of the United Institute of Technology (UIT), Allahabad

United Institute of Technology (UIT), located in Allahabad, offers B. Tech courses in 7 different specializations. Students need to have completed their 10+2 (as required by the state government) with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics from a recognized board. Students are then selected for admission via the Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling (UPTAC) exam. The first-year fees are INR 1.31 Lakhs - INR 1.45 Lakhs.

For B. Tech (Lateral Entry), the students are required to hold a diploma in engineering from a recognized institution with a minimum of 60% marks. The first-year fees for Lateral Entry students are also INR 1.31 Lakhs - INR 1.45 Lakhs. Applications for Lateral Entry are being accepted now.

UIT also offers M. Tech programs with 2 specializations. The minimum admission requirements include a relevant bachelor's degree with a minimum of 60% marks to ensure that the students are sufficiently ready for the rigors of postgraduate study. The first-year fee for M. Tech is INR 1.11 Lakhs.

Ques. What are the B.Tech specializations offered at the United Institute of Technology, Allahabad?

Ans. United Institute of Technology (UIT), Allahabad provides specializations in B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Civil Engineering. The institutes' specializations are structured with the idea of providing theoretical knowledge and practical technical skills.
Ques. How is the B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at the United Institute of Technology?

Ans. The B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at the United Institute of Technology is respected for its industry-based curriculum, modern infrastructure, and good faculty members. Students enjoy various practical sessions/ workshops, coding labs, and technical seminars, preparing them better for a software career in IT.
Ques. What is the Quality of faculty at the United Institute of Technology, Allahabad?

Ans. The quality of faculty at the United Institute of Technology is likely good, qualified, experienced, and helpful. Faculty provide academic guidance, guide student project work, and support students in preparing for the technical questions included in competitions, making a positive academic experience.
Ques. Does the United Institute of Technology, Allahabad, provide placement assistance for B.Tech students?

Ans. Yes, the college gives placement training as well as career development with dedicated campus drives to help students find jobs along with soft skills training (interpersonal skills) and mock interviews. The students can apply for jobs in core companies along with IT companies with roles in Engineering, Software development, and Operations.
Ques. Are internships available for B.Tech students at the United Institute of Technology?

Ans. The United Institute of Technology offers students the ability to take internships while in school. Many students were able to land internships through the college's partnerships with companies and government organizations where they gained valuable experience in industry.
Ques. What is the infrastructure like at the United Institute of Technology, Allahabad?

Ans. The college has well-supported teaching staff and well-maintained classrooms that feel modern along with well-supported teaching laboratories, a central library with lots of quotations, and several dedicated computer centers. They also provide Wi-Fi throughout the campus, hostels for students, and sports facilities, all creating a great learning environment for students.

MCC Chennai, also known as Madras Christian College, is an autonomous college established in 1837 in Chennai. MCC Chennai also has an NAAC accreditation with an A grade. The institute is approved by UGC. MCC Chennai has been ranked 16th by Collegedunia for Arts in 2026.

Admission to the majority of courses at MCC Chennai is based on merit in Class 12 (for UG admission) and Graduation (for PG admission). Some of the details regarding the eligibility & selection criteria of MCC Chennai are mentioned below:

For UG admissions, the online application portal opens on 23 February 2026. Applicants must have their 10+2 marks, as applications without these marks are not accepted. Students who completed Class 12 in previous years or from other boards can also apply if they already have their mark sheets. The admission process begins only after the Tamil Nadu Class 12 results are officially declared.

For PG admissions, candidates can apply using their first five semesters’ marks. They must upload all relevant mark sheets and documents during the application process. PG applicants need to apply using the “Result Published” login, as there is no option to update marks later. Once submitted, marks cannot be edited or changed.

While I appreciate St. Joseph's College, I have to mention PSG Arts and Science College in Coimbatore as a solid option too. The Bachelor of Computer Applications [BCA] course there offers a well-structured curriculum and the faculty is quite experienced. The college also arranges internships with well-known companies, which is crucial for job readiness. The fees are manageable, making it accessible for many students. They also have various clubs and activities that make campus life enjoyable. Both colleges have their strengths, but the choice really depends on what you're looking for.

If you're all about diving deep into your studies, Loyola College is the place to be. But if you're looking to grow personally and become more well-rounded, Madras Christian College offers that transformation. You might start at MCC as a kid, but you'll walk out as a true Gentleman.

Among these, Loyola College Chennai is the superior college. It has a central location, at the heart of Chennai. Loyola is widely reputed especially for Visual Communication courses. The college has a dedicated pool of faculty. As a student of the institute, you will have access to good learning resources and facilities. It has a good placement record as well. During Loyola College placements 2021, students received an average CTC of INR 5.25 LPA.
You should choose Loyola College. It is considered among the best colleges in Tamil Nadu and offers good academics. The institute has strict rules in place regarding academics and attendance.
Loyola has a well-maintained 99 acres campus in the middle of the city. There are good hangout places near the campus.
Loyola College Chennai placements have been good over the years. During the 2021 placement drive, students received an average CTC of around INR 5.25 LPA.

Madras Christian College doesn’t have a strict dress code. The management instructs students to dress decently. Students are allowed to wear semi-formals. The dress code also depends on the department. Some departments are liberal while some departments are strict. Usually, girls aren’t allowed to wear sleeveless dresses or skirts.

I have friends from all three institutes. According to their experience, I will say St. Joseph College Trichy is a better option. It has good infrastructural facilities and a decent library. The faculties are decent. The college has strict rules regarding attendance. A minimum of 80% subject-wise attendance is necessary.

One of my friends studied at SJC College Trichy. He completed his Post Graduation in Botany from this college. He is still proud of his time as a student at SJC. Here are some facts about the college you should know.

Most of my friend’s classmates became teachers, and they are doing well. The students absorbed not only knowledge but also values. He still recalls and adores his professors because he feels he owes them a debt of gratitude.
There is not much difference when we talk about the course and the subjects but the environment is significantly different for both. Here are some things that you should know about the institutes.

Freedom- MCC offers a lot of freedom to its students in the way they dress and express themselves as compared to Loyola. Even for attendance, it is not as strict as Loyola. Loyola asks its students to pay for condonation and then sit for an exam.
Ragging- It is still very much prevalent at MCC and sometimes it crosses the healthy limit as well. On the other hand, ragging is very rare at Loyola.
Drug scene- MCC is infamous for its drug-related incidents. While enrolling their children, parents are quite worried about this. On the other hand, Loyola does not have such a problem.
Campus- Both the campuses are extremely beautiful with an amazing experience of studying in the college.

College life- When it comes to cultural and extracurricular activities, MCC is more active as compared to Loyola. They conduct a lot of fests and different events which offer its students a lot of opportunities.
Here is a brief overview of the institutes.

Therefore, it depends completely on what you want out of your college. If you want a good college life then you should opt for MCC. But if you want good academics then you should opt for Loyola. MCC has a diversified culture whereas Loyola has students mostly from Chennai.

Ques. How competitive is the PGIMER entrance for PG courses?

Ans. PGIMER entrance for PG (MD/MS) courses is very competitive. Admission is based on INI-CET ranks, and for top branches like Radiodiagnosis, the closing rank can be as low as 13 for the General category. For most MD courses, ranks range from 2 to around 10,800, depending on the round and branch. For OBC, SC, and ST categories, the closing ranks can go up to 20,000 and above. Usually, candidates need to score above the 50th percentile (General) or 45th percentile (Reserved) to get a seat. Because of this, the exam needs strong preparation and is considered one of the toughest PG medical entrance exams in India.
Ques. Are hostel facilities available for PG students at PGIMER Chandigarh?

Ans. Yes, PGI Chandigarh offers hostel accommodation for PG students. Separate hostels for men and women are available with furnished rooms, mess facilities, 24/7 security, Wi-Fi, study areas, and recreational spaces, ensuring a safe and supportive environment for academics and research.

To get admission to the MD/MS programs at PGIMER Chandigarh, candidates must qualify for the INI-CET entrance exam, complete their MBBS degree along with a compulsory internship, and follow the online application and counseling process. Admission is merit-based, and seats are allocated according to rank, preference, and category.

For B.Sc. programs, Candidates must have completed Class 12 (10+2). For BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy): Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English (PCB and E). For B.Optom (Bachelor of Optometry): 10+2 or equivalent in the Science stream.

Ques. Does NMAMIT accept COMEDK scores?

Ans. NMAM Institute of Technology (NMAMIT considers COMEDK UGET scores for admission to its undergraduate engineering courses. COMEDK (Consortium of Medical, Engineering and Dental Colleges of Karnataka) is a well-known entrance test for non-Karnataka students for admission to private engineering colleges in Karnataka. The students who have qualified in COMEDK and have the minimum eligibility criteria (10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics) can apply for B.E. degrees in various courses at NMAMIT via the COMEDK counselling procedure. Some percentage of seats in every branch are kept in reserve for admission under the COMEDK quota, so it provides a good choice for students from other than Karnataka.
Ques. Are there student clubs and events?

Ans. NMAMIT also has a very wide area of campus, along with multiple student clubs and activities to entertain. Some of the famous clubs on campus are the Aero Club, Developer Student Club, Yoga Club, and Finite Loop Club, which offer students a platform to participate in technical, cultural, and extracurricular activities. The institute organises major events such as INVENTE, its technical fest held every year, and INSIGNIA, the cultural fest, and intercollegiate competitions. These events and clubs assist students in developing their leadership, teamwork, and technical skills while creating a dynamic and diversified campus culture.
Ques. Is NMAMIT autonomous?

Ans. NMAM Institute of Technology (NMAMIT), Nitte, is an academically autonomous engineering college initially affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi. The autonomous status is given to the Institute by VTU starting from the 2007–08 academic year, which granted the institute the freedom to design and update its own curriculum, examination systems, and academic regulations. Though NMAMIT became part of Nitte (Deemed to be University) as a constituent college in June 2022, it still functions with autonomous status, which provides it the freedom to provide industry-relevant, flexible, and innovative academic courses.

While I appreciate St. Joseph's College, I have to mention PSG Arts and Science College in Coimbatore as a solid option too. The Bachelor of Computer Applications [BCA] course there offers a well-structured curriculum and the faculty is quite experienced. The college also arranges internships with well-known companies, which is crucial for job readiness. The fees are manageable, making it accessible for many students. They also have various clubs and activities that make campus life enjoyable. Both colleges have their strengths, but the choice really depends on what you're looking for.

If you're all about diving deep into your studies, Loyola College is the place to be. But if you're looking to grow personally and become more well-rounded, Madras Christian College offers that transformation. You might start at MCC as a kid, but you'll walk out as a true Gentleman.

Among these, Loyola College Chennai is the superior college. It has a central location, at the heart of Chennai. Loyola is widely reputed especially for Visual Communication courses. The college has a dedicated pool of faculty. As a student of the institute, you will have access to good learning resources and facilities. It has a good placement record as well. During Loyola College placements 2021, students received an average CTC of INR 5.25 LPA.
You should choose Loyola College. It is considered among the best colleges in Tamil Nadu and offers good academics. The institute has strict rules in place regarding academics and attendance.
Loyola has a well-maintained 99 acres campus in the middle of the city. There are good hangout places near the campus.
Loyola College Chennai placements have been good over the years. During the 2021 placement drive, students received an average CTC of around INR 5.25 LPA.

Madras Christian College doesn’t have a strict dress code. The management instructs students to dress decently. Students are allowed to wear semi-formals. The dress code also depends on the department. Some departments are liberal while some departments are strict. Usually, girls aren’t allowed to wear sleeveless dresses or skirts.

I have friends from all three institutes. According to their experience, I will say St. Joseph College Trichy is a better option. It has good infrastructural facilities and a decent library. The faculties are decent. The college has strict rules regarding attendance. A minimum of 80% subject-wise attendance is necessary.

One of my friends studied at SJC College Trichy. He completed his Post Graduation in Botany from this college. He is still proud of his time as a student at SJC. Here are some facts about the college you should know.

Most of my friend’s classmates became teachers, and they are doing well. The students absorbed not only knowledge but also values. He still recalls and adores his professors because he feels he owes them a debt of gratitude.
There is not much difference when we talk about the course and the subjects but the environment is significantly different for both. Here are some things that you should know about the institutes.

Freedom- MCC offers a lot of freedom to its students in the way they dress and express themselves as compared to Loyola. Even for attendance, it is not as strict as Loyola. Loyola asks its students to pay for condonation and then sit for an exam.
Ragging- It is still very much prevalent at MCC and sometimes it crosses the healthy limit as well. On the other hand, ragging is very rare at Loyola.
Drug scene- MCC is infamous for its drug-related incidents. While enrolling their children, parents are quite worried about this. On the other hand, Loyola does not have such a problem.
Campus- Both the campuses are extremely beautiful with an amazing experience of studying in the college.

College life- When it comes to cultural and extracurricular activities, MCC is more active as compared to Loyola. They conduct a lot of fests and different events which offer its students a lot of opportunities.
Here is a brief overview of the institutes.

Therefore, it depends completely on what you want out of your college. If you want a good college life then you should opt for MCC. But if you want good academics then you should opt for Loyola. MCC has a diversified culture whereas Loyola has students mostly from Chennai.

Christian Medical College (CMC) Vellore, established in 1900, is a private medical institution based in Vellore. It is affiliated with Tamil Nadu Dr. MGR Medical University and regulated by the National Medical Commission. The college offers UG, PG, and super-speciality programs in medicine and allied health sciences.

Admissions are based on national-level exams such as NEET UG, NEET PG, and NEET SS, followed by an internal application and selection process conducted by the institution. CMC Vellore is ranked 4th in 2025 by Collegedunia.
Direct Link: Apply Now for CMC Vellore Admission 2026

Note: Christian Medical College, Vellore, offers 100 MBBS seats split into 50% management and 50% government quotas, including Minority Network (38), Staff (10), Tamil Nadu Christian Minority (20), and 2 General Open seats.

MBBS admission at CMC Vellore is based on NEET UG rank. Candidates will have to register for the Tamil Nadu NEET UG counseling for seat allocation. Tabulated are the key event dates related to the MBBS program:

Christian Medical College offers MBBS, B.Sc. in Nursing, and B.Sc. in Allied Health Sciences as its popular programs. CMC Vellore MBBS first-year fees are INR 84,330. Tabulated below are the details of the CMC Vellore courses and fees:

CMC Vellore offers admission to undergraduate, postgraduate, and super-specialty medical and allied health programs based on national-level entrance exams, institutional selection processes, and merit, in accordance with regulatory authorities. Candidates must meet the required academic eligibility (generally 45 - 50% in qualifying exams for UG programs).

CMC Vellore admissions are conducted through NEET-based counseling, institutional entrance tests (where applicable), and merit-based selection depending on the course and latest government guidelines.
• MBBS: Admission is based on NEET-UG, followed by DME counseling.
• BPT (Physiotherapy) / BOT (Occupational Therapy): Admission is based on NEET-UG merit, as per Allied Healthcare regulations. Candidates may also need to appear for the CMC Vellore Entrance Test.
• Allied Health Sciences (B.Sc. Courses): Selection is based on merit and the CMC Entrance Examination, depending on regulatory updates.
• MD / MS (Postgraduate Medical): Admission is based on NEET-PG followed by counseling and institutional selection criteria.
• M.Ch / DM (Super Specialty): Admission is based on NEET-SS, followed by further selection procedures.
• M.Sc. (Nursing & Allied Sciences): Admission is based on academic merit, eligibility criteria, and institutional selection processes.
Selection is based on MD/DNB qualification, interview, and departmental requirements.

CMC Vellore follows a transparent, merit-based admission process aligned with national guidelines. All postgraduate admissions occur through NEET-PG 2026 or NEET-SS 2025, followed by CMC-conducted practical tests and interviews.

Ques. Are donations or agent-mediated admissions possible at CMC Vellore?

Ans. Absolutely not. CMC Vellore explicitly states that no fees, donations, or capitation charges are accepted beyond the prescribed tuition and administrative fees. All admissions occur through merit-based NEET scores and transparent counselling processes. Any person approaching you with offers of "guaranteed admission" through agents or payments is fraudulent. Such attempts should be reported to law enforcement immediately. The college publishes a formal caution warning the public against agent-mediated admissions.
Ques. Can foreign medical graduates apply for postgraduate programs at CMC Vellore?

Ans. Yes, foreign medical graduates (FMGs) can apply for MD/MS and super specialty programs if they meet these criteria: (a) completed medical degree from recognized university in their home country, (b) cleared the FMG Screening Test conducted by NMC, (c) obtained valid NEET-PG or NEET-SS score, (d) obtained NMC No Objection Certificate from the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. FMGs follow the same merit-based selection as Indian graduates but appear on a separate merit list. They must also obtain NMC approval before joining the course.
Ques. Does CMC Vellore offer hostel accommodation to all admitted students?

Ans. CMC Vellore provides partly furnished accommodation on campus depending on availability. Hostel housing is not guaranteed for all students; availability depends on capacity and the number of applications. Students unable to secure an on-campus hostel must arrange private accommodation in Vellore town. The Modale International Hostel specifically serves overseas elective students and visiting researchers. Postgraduate trainees are more likely to receive accommodation than undergraduate students due to limited capacity.
Ques. When will CMC Vellore announce the cutoff for 2026 admissions?

Ans. CMC Vellore does not publish the cutoff in advance; cutoff ranks are finalized only after NEET 2026 results are declared. However, based on historical patterns, the general category NEET UG cutoff is expected to be around 800 - 1,200 ranks for MBBS admission. For postgraduate programs, the NEET-PG cutoff typically falls in the top 5% of test-takers.
Ques. Is NEET-SS mandatory for super-specialty admission at CMC Vellore?

Ans. Yes, NEET-SS (Super Specialty) qualification is mandatory for DM/MCH program admission. Candidates must have obtained a valid NEET-SS 2025 score. The selection process occurs through DGHS common counseling, where merit-based ranking determines seat allocation. Only NEET-SS-qualified candidates are considered; NEET-PG scores alone are insufficient for super-specialty programs. Candidates should register for NEET-SS 2025 and ensure they obtain a score before the admission timeline begins.
Ques. Does CMC Vellore accept online classes or distance education for medical programs?

Ans. No, all medical programs at CMC Vellore are full-time, in-person training programs. MBBS requires 5 years of continuous on-campus presence with mandatory clinical rotations. Postgraduate MD/MS programs are full-time in-service training lasting 3 years with no external employment permitted. Distance learning or online components are not offered for any medical program. Students must be physically present on campus for all clinical and didactic sessions.
Ques. Can I apply for CMC Vellore super specialty after completing an MD from another college?

Ans. Yes, you are eligible to apply for DM/MCH programs at CMC Vellore if you hold an MD/MS degree from any recognized medical university and have completed required post-MBBS experience. You must obtain a valid NEET-SS 2025 score and participate in DGHS common counselling. All MD graduates are considered equally regardless of the college where they graduated; selection is purely merit-based on NEET-SS rank.

CMC Vellore is primarily a teaching hospital and medical college — one of India's best for medical education, research, and tertiary care. it's a non-profit institution. exceptional for rare and complex cases. billing is more affordable than Apollo for similar procedures. best for those seeking treatment with strong academic/teaching hospital expertise.

comparison for treatment quality: both are excellent. CMC has historically been stronger in research and specialized treatments (oncology, neurology).
