Lady Brabourne College, Kolkata, established in 1939, is a public women's college that is affiliated with the University of Calcutta. It is accredited by NAAC with an grade A for 3 consecutive cycles. It is ranked 47th in India in the overall category, according to NIRF in 2025. Lady Brabourne College offers UG and PG courses in Arts, Science, and various specialised programs through merit-based admission methods.

Lady Brabourne College offers various UG courses such as B.Sc., B.A., and advanced research programs. Among them, the B.Sc.(Honours) is its most popular program. The UG program fee for the first year ranges from INR 3,576 to INR 4,416. Admission for the B.Sc. program is based on the eligibility criteria that candidates must have qualified 10+2, and the selection is via a merit-based system through the West Bengal Centralised Admission Portal (WBCAP).

Lady Brabourne College has not released its placement data for the year 2025. According to the NIRF 2024 report, the 2024 placement concluded with 9 students being placed at the UG and PG levels. The median package the students received at both UG and PG was INR 3 LPA. The top recruiters for the institute are Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Cognizant Technology Solutions, Tech Mahindra, and Wipro.

Lady Brabourne College offers various UG, PG, and research programs in different branches of science and arts. Admission to the majority of the courses is merit-based.

Lady Brabourne College admission is provided through the West Bengal Centralised Admission Portal (WBCAP) for undergraduate programs. (Honours) in 19 different subjects require candidates to meet specific eligibility criteria based on their 10+2 performance.

Lady Brabourne College also offers PG courses in M.A., M.Sc., and various research programs designed for students pursuing advanced academic specialisation and research careers. The PG admissions are carried out through direct admission for some courses and entrance examinations for others, conducted by the University of Calcutta.

Lady Brabourne College is situated in Kolkata's Beniapukur area, opposite the Park Circus Maidan. The campus features lush green lawns and gardens with heritage colonial architecture combined with modern facilities. It has separate buildings for different departments, well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms with ICT facilities, a comprehensive library, and the Veronica Auditorium for events and conferences.

The campus also provides hostel facilities for female students, medical units, a gymnasium, a canteen, common rooms, and various recreational facilities. Lady Brabourne College maintains a campus-wide network with Wi-Fi connectivity, computer centres, and modern infrastructure that support both academic and research activities.

Lady Brabourne College offers a vibrant campus life through numerous student clubs, sports activities, and cultural programs that complement academic learning. The college hosts various departments, including the Athletic Club, Drama Club, Student Council, and Students' Welfare Club, each contributing to the comprehensive development of students. Lady Brabourne College maintains active NCC and NSS units that engage students in community service and national development activities.

The college's commitment to student welfare is evident through its comprehensive support systems, including the Student Grievance Redressal Committee, Anti-Ragging Cell, Equal Opportunity Cell, and Psychological Counselling Cell. Lady Brabourne College provides specialised support for differently-abled students and maintains cells for socio-economically disadvantaged groups, ensuring an inclusive educational environment.
Here is the list of some Notable Alumni from Lady Brabourne College.
Ques. What are the research opportunities available at Lady Brabourne College?

Ans. Lady Brabourne College houses six Advanced Research Centres approved by the University of Calcutta, including the Rabindranath Tagore Advanced Research Centre, Centre for Advanced Research on Human Geography, and Advanced Research Centre for Applied Biochemistry and Microbiology. The college offers Ph.D. programs in various departments and regularly publishes research papers. Students can engage in interdisciplinary research projects and collaborate with national and international institutions.
Ques. What type of hands-on learning experiences do students receive at Lady Brabourne College?

Ans. Students at Lady Brabourne College receive extensive practical exposure through well-equipped laboratories, field trips, excursions, and project work. Science students have access to modern laboratory equipment and participate in research projects. The college also offers computer literacy programs through WEBEL collaboration and provides opportunities for students to present papers at national conferences and seminars.
Ques. What facilities are available in the Lady Brabourne College library?

Ans. The Lady Brabourne College library features digital cataloguing with the OPAC (Online Public Access Catalogue) system, an extensive collection of books, journals, and periodicals, e-resources and access to digital libraries via INFLIBNET. The library provides separate reading rooms, internet facilities, and departmental seminar libraries for postgraduate students. It maintains a peaceful academic environment with extended working hours during examination periods.
Ques. How does Lady Brabourne College support differently-abled students?

Ans. Lady Brabourne College maintains a barrier-free environment with ramps and accessible facilities for differently-abled students. The college provides special support through the Equal Opportunity Cell and ensures that differently-abled students receive necessary assistance during examinations and daily activities. Infrastructure is designed to accommodate students with various physical challenges, and faculty members are sensitised to provide appropriate academic support.
Ques. What makes the Lady Brabourne College different from other women's colleges in West Bengal?

Ans. Lady Brabourne College stands out with its multicultural heritage, having evolved from an institution originally meant for Muslim women to a diverse college serving students from all communities. The college combines traditional values with modern education, houses six Advanced Research Centres, maintains NAAC 'A' grade accreditation for three consecutive cycles, and has achieved significant national rankings. Its location opposite Park Circus Maidan provides a serene academic environment in the heart of Kolkata.

Lady Brabourne College is one of the best options under CU for a B.A or B.Sc. The faculty base of the Economics department is excellent. Classes are held regularly. The faculty members are also patient about clearing doubts. Although there are a few cons regarding the CU syllabus, overall Lady Brabourne is a great option for pursuing a degree in Economics.

It depends on the subject that you are applying to. The required cutoff varies depending on the subject. For admission, some department accepts students based on their board marks. While for some departments, you will need to seat for an entrance test. Usually, to get admission at Lady Brabourne College, you will need more than 60% in aggregate with a minimum of 75% in your subject of preference.
One of my friends studied in Lady Brabourne College with Physics (Hons). The criteria was an exact 100 in physics. The criteria for other boards may be equal or vary.
This might have changed over the years, but chances are very less if you have scored less than 95.
St Xavier’s College’ Chemistry (Hons.) criteria is around 95–98%. Some students with 90% or above will get admission through 3rd or 4th list if there are vacant seats.

Therefore to secure a seat, your overall percentage must be more than 95 and in the subject you want to pursue for your honors, you must have a higher score than 97, from whichever board you graduate from.
It will depend on the cut-off marks as set up by the college. It differs from year to year. If you score above 85 your chances of getting selected in the first round will be easier.

Later it will gradually drop down to 75-80. This will also vary among students of reserved and unreserved categories. Students belonging to reserved categories might require a lower score like 70-75, which can drop down to 60-65, depending on the course and the college’s set cut off.
The class timings are 10 AM to 4:30 PM. The Honours classes can take place at any time of the day.
The day might begin with an honours class with the very last class being for honours subject too.
All the departments are very strict, so you cannot skip any of the honours classes if you have attended one already.
You must be very particular with attendance in college as it is strictly checked. Failure to maintain a 70% attendance will restrict you from sitting in the selection exams.
Admissions will be according to the rules of Calcutta University that is through overall merit and entrance exams conducted by the university.
For B.Sc. you will require a score of 85% or above to secure a seat for admission. It also depends on the subject you are applying for.
To qualify in the first round of counselling you will require a minimum of 93% aggregate, but this percentage gradually drops down to 87–88% in the second counselling.

It also depends on the basis they calculate the percentile, like for Economics, mathematics marks is considered. The cut off for microbiology and statistics are much higher when compared to other science subjects, so it varies.
The hostels at Lady Brabourne College, (LBC) Kolkata are very basic and usual. The building is very old with corridors having fewer lights making it difficult to walk around.

Many students opt to stay in the hostel but if you want an alternative you can choose to stay as a paying guest. There are many places nearby. The people here are very cooperative and overall it is a good college, so there will not be many problems.

Lady Brabourne is comparably better for a Political Science (Hons). It is one of the top colleges in Kolkata. The faculty base is great. However, it is quite difficult to get admission at the institute as the number of seats is limited. They are also quite strict regarding attendance.

Loreto College is also one of the most reputed colleges in Kolkata. And both Lady Brabourne and Loreto come under Calcutta University. So, you will take the same examinations and go through the same evaluation process.
My sister studied economics at Lady Brabourne College for 3 years and from that experience, she came to realize that Jadavpur University would've been the better option.
The subjects taught at Lady Brabourne College were very hectic and lengthy answers were asked in exams and even then you will be given low marks.

Whereas in Jadavpur university, the faculty number is vast and they are all very well read and experts in their fields. Amartya Sen is one of the JU professors. You will find that the semesters are well spaced too so that even if you study all year long, it won't feel like a burden. Economics has not only a very advanced syllabus but also a very brilliant faculty who focus on the development of students and remain unaffected by university politics.
One thing is for sure, that as a JU student you will not require tuition fees because the faculty will always be ready to solve all your doubts and answer each query.

Both Godavari Institute of Engineering & Technology (GIET) and Pragati Engineering College are private, autonomous engineering institutions in Andhra Pradesh, approved by AICTE and affiliated with Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU). Each is accredited by the NBA and has received NAAC A+ or A‑grade recognition, highlighting their academic quality. Both campuses emphasize practical learning through industry-relevant collaborations—Godavari Global University with Apple, Oracle, Red Hat, and Satyam, and Pragati via its AWS Academy, Cisco Networking Academy, Pearson Vue testing centre, and GeeksforGeeks chapter. Each college offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate engineering programs, including CSE, ECE, EEE, and mechanical disciplines, and hosts robust placement cells that regularly attract top recruiters like TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, and Accenture. Both foster vibrant campus life through technical and cultural events, sports facilities, and an emphasis on soft-skill development alongside academics. Godavari Global University places significant emphasis on physical well-being, offering a comprehensive range of sports and fitness amenities:
Ques. What are the sports facilities available at Godavari Global University?

Ans. Godavari Global University East Godavari offers a comprehensive range of sports facilities to support the physical well-being and extracurricular interests of its students. The campus features three badminton courts (one for women and two for men), a cement-layered basketball court, two cricket fields, a football field, two kabaddi courts, two table tennis tables, two 200-meter athletic tracks, six volleyball courts, two throw ball courts for women, four cricket net practice courts, a snooker table, 20 chess boards, four carrom boards, and four shuttle courts. These amenities are complemented by experienced physical education directors who guide and encourage students to participate in local leagues and competitive events, fostering a vibrant sports culture on campus
Ques. What cultural fest does Godavari Global University conduct?

Ans. Godavari Global University East Godavari conducts major cultural fests such as "GIET_Fiesta - Medha," an annual youth event, and "Maitri," another electrifying annual youth event. These festivals attract large participation, with Maitri, for example, drawing over 25,000 students from various engineering colleges across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, showcasing the vibrant cultural life and enthusiasm of the Godavari Global University campus community.
Ques. Does Godavari Global University East Godavari offer accommodation facilities?

Ans. Yes, Godavari Global University East Godavari offers separate accommodation facilities for boys and girls with well-managed hostels on its sprawling 300-acre campus. The boys' hostel can accommodate around 550 students, while the girls' hostel has a capacity of about 400 students. The hostels provide basic amenities including furnished rooms, security, and hygienic food served twice a day. Although some reviews mention average food quality and occasional maintenance issues, the overall hostel environment supports a comfortable stay for students, contributing to a balanced campus life experience

Air Conditioned classes: The College is centrally air-conditioned with projectors available in individual classes and WI-FI connectivity. Faculties conduct classes on projectors with the facility of blackboards to aid the process of lectures and doubt clearance of students.

Sports Facility: The College provides several sports facilities to its students to enhance their physical, mental, social, and emotional capability. The sports facility consists of both indoor and outdoor activities. The institute has badminton courts as well as basketball courts. Apart from usual sport activity students of this college take part in inter-college badminton tournaments, basketball tournaments, and a host of other sports events.
Canteen/ Cafeteria: The College canteen has a variety of food options cooked in a hygienic environment. Besides the food served by the canteen is tasty and available at a reasonable price.
Auditorium: There is an air-conditioned auditorium equipped with modern facilities where several cultural activities and student & faculty felicitation activities take place.

Ques. How Ragging is addressed in SSC West Bengal?
Ans. Ragging is strictly prohibited in the College premises. Instances of ragging will be dealt with The ragging cell of the College seriously by taking following measures:
1. Suspension from attending classes/duties for a stipulated period of time
2. Withholding/withdrawing scholarship/fellowship/freeship and other benefits
3. Withholding results for sometime
4. Debarring from representing the Institution in any academic platform/forum
5. Cancellation of admission depending on the severity of the offence
6. Collaborating and communicating with the parents of the offender
7. Providing counselling support
Ques. Does SSC West Bengal Organises any events?

Ans. SSC West Bengal organises many events all round the year like HIndi Diwas, Baishe Shraban, Foundation Day, International Literacy Day, Shree, Vidyasagar Diwas, Podium, Srijan, International Womens Day, and many more. Not only these events are celebrated, they are also featured in The College Magazine with the name of “ Brewing Minds” . This annual Magazine covers up all the minute details of the event.
Ques. How the Placement Cell works in SSC West Bengal?

Ans.SSC West Bengal Placement Cell endeavors to bridge a gap between Industry and Academia through arrays ofactivities like facilitating Placements and Internships, LiveProjects, Guest Lectures by Industry Veterans, Alumni Mentorship, Work Shops, Industry Visits and Industry MoU’s.The Placement cell organizes regular Soft Skills, Aptitude Training. The Placement cell provides internship opportunities to students so that they are accustomed to meet the dynamics of the Corporate World. Placement assistance is given to Graduates and Post Graduates final year students irrespective of the streams subject to availability.
Ques. Does SSC West Bengal supports AISHE?

Ans. To portray the status of higher education in the country, Ministry of Education has endeavoured to conduct an annual web-based All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) since 2010-11.The survey involves all institutions in the country engaged in imparting higher education. Data is being collected on several parameters such as teachers, student enrolment, programmes, examination results, education finance and infrastructure.These are useful in making informed policy decisions about higher education institutions. Moreover, the data collected through AISHE is utilized in research for development of education sector.

Both Loreto College and Shri Shikshayatan College are the most reputed all-girls colleges in Kolkata. Choosing any one of them will prove to be a good step up for your career.

Loreto College is popular for its English Honours course. It is more strict compared to any other college. Students here have to maintain a 80% attendance, failing which you will not be able to sit for the examination. Also for subjects with practicals, students have to maintain a 100% attendance in labs. The faculty of the English department is highly experienced with some professors having 15-20 years of educational experience.

Shri Shikshayatan College is a bit more liberal than Loreto. It is not so strict about certain rules and students have the freedom to explore. The attendance, dress code, academics, etc. are much more lenient than Loreto. But according to the education provided both are equally good. Choose the one that meets all your requirements, as only that can give you a fulfilling college life.

Yes, Shri Shikshayatan is an all girls college located in one of the posh areas of Kolkata. It is one of the most well reputed girls colleges in the country. They have a well maintained infrastructure, and all the necessary facilities, along with a gym, swimming pool, basketball court, etc.

They also encourage students to develop not only academically but holistically as well. They have various clubs students can take part in and learn different skills, like dance, drama, music, photography, business, coding, etc. Thus it is a well constructed college students can opt for.

Both Bhawanipur Education Society and Shri Shikshayatan are reputed colleges in Kolkata. They admit their students on a merit basis. Their cut off is usually high but if you have average scores you will get a chance in their 2nd or 3rd lists.

Shri Shikshayatan is an all girls college and requires a better academic record. Both colleges are more or less the same. They differ in infrastructure, faculty and overall fees. Shri Shikshayatan has better infrastructure than Bhawanipur with better well maintained buildings, auditorium, gym and swimming pool.

Bhawanipur encourages students to join their college clubs and committees, they believe in the holistic development of the students along with academics. The college hosts, organizes and takes part in several inter-college festivals, cultural activities, competitions, etc. which take place all year long. If you prefer being around such activities then Bhawanipur is the right place for you.

The choice entirely depends on the individual and where his or her interests lie. Both are reputed institutions, so you will enjoy the perks these brands offer, you just have to choose what interests you more. A culturally active college or a college mostly inclined towards academics.

A BA or B.Sc. students have class timings from 10 AM to 4 PM. B.Com students have both morning and evening classes. BBA only has morning shifts.

Rajasthan College of Engineering for Women, popularly known as RCEW, is a private institute spread across 5 acres in Jaipur. Established in 2002. RCEW is affiliated with Rajasthan Technical University, Kota, approved by AICTE, and accredited by NAAC.

RCEW offers courses at UG and PG levels with B.Tech being the flagship program in 4 specialisations, M.Tech in 3 specialisations, MBA in 3 specialisations, and an MCA course. Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Pune, also known as VIT Pune, established in 1983. It is an autonomous institute affiliated with Savitribai Phule University and accredited with NAAC “A++” Grade. The institute is also approved by AICTE. The Times of India ranked VIT Pune B.Tech 34 under the “Engineering” category.

VIT Pune offers B.Tech, M.Tech, B.Tech lateral, and PhD courses. B.Tech is its most popular program with specializations like Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, and Mechanical Engineering. Admission to B.Tech at VIT Pune is based on MHT-CET merit and JEE Main scores. Ques. Is Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT Pune) a private or government college?

Ques. Is Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT Pune) considered a good college for engineering studies?

Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT Pune) is recognized as a reputable institution for technical education, known for its commitment to academic excellence, innovation, and industry relevance. While what makes a college "good" can vary based on individual preferences, VIT stands out for several key reasons. It boasts a distinguished faculty consisting of researchers, industry experts, and experienced professors dedicated to providing high-quality education and guidance to students.
Ques. What is the quality of the MCA program at VIT Pune?

Ans. VIT Pune offers a highly regarded MCA program. The practical sessions are very well-structured to enhance learning. Students gain diverse experiences that support their career growth. Annually, around 95% of MCA students secure placements in reputable companies. The highest salary package offered is 29 LPA, the average salary is between 7-8 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA.
Ques. What is the ranking for Vishwakarma Institute of Technology Pune?

Ans. Founded in 1983, Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT) Pune is linked with Savitribai Phule Pune University and is AICTE-approved. The institute has an 'A+' NAAC accreditation with a CGPA of 3.14. VIT Pune offers 19 courses, with admissions based on national exams. It supports students with scholarships and various facilities. In the India Today Ranking 2025, VIT Pune has been ranked 52 among engineering institutions. In addition, TOI ranked the institute 32nd for B.Tech in 2025.
Ques. What is the most popular program at Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT) Pune?

Ans. Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT) in Pune is a prestigious autonomous engineering college. The standout program here is the Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Engineering. This course is the institute's flagship and has gained significant recognition. The curriculum is up-to-date, covering the latest in computer science, and aligns with industry needs and employer expectations.
Ques. Is VIT Pune considered a Tier 1 or Tier 2 college?

Ans. Yes, VIT Pune is categorized as a Tier 2 college. It offers a range of UG, PG, and Ph.D. programs and provides all necessary facilities. The campus life is vibrant, featuring numerous clubs such as the Merchantile Club, GedIT Club, and Financial Literacy Club, among others.

so if someone is comparing "VIT Pune" vs "Vishwakarma University Pune" — they're comparing the same college pre and post university status grant. they're not two separate colleges.

I can enlighten you about the schedule of first shift students at VIT Pune.

Morning classes start at 8am. Those who aren’t lucky enough to have a vehicle of their own, reach the campus by climbing the famous VIT slope. Walking to the college becomes especially tough during the rainy season as one has to walk in the opposite direction to pouring rain.

Some professors are very particular about time, and close the doors at sharp 8 am. After 2-3 lectures of an hour each, one gets an hour-long break. During this time, one eats at either of the two canteens or Poona Bakery. The break is followed by more lecture/lab sessions. After this, either one is free, or some more lectures commence after another break.

Not all days are the same. Sometimes one gets free after 3 hours, while other times, classes and labs may even stretch to 8 hours. One usually gets free by 3pm. Saturday is a holiday for SE, TE and BE. Freshers have to attend general proficiency courses for 2 hours on Saturdays. GP includes Photography, Chess, Guitar, Violin, Yoga, Aerobics and other interesting hobbies. No leaves are awarded before exams, but the syllabus is quite manageable.
This is the basic routine of first shift B.Tech students at VIT Pune. You’ll face a fair share of challenges, but in the end, you’ll be left with everlasting memories.

As a student of B.Tech ENTC at VIT Pune, I can shed some light on this branch.

ENTC is one of the best branches of VIT Pune. It is an autonomous college, so it freely decides its course curriculum. The syllabus is industry relevant, and will equip you for higher studies. The curriculum contains skill development courses which will help you during placements and projects.

The department offers honors in fields like Robotics, Embedded System Design and VLSI. These additional courses carry extra credits. Instead of assignments, the new curriculum focuses on labs and mini projects. Many students opt for industry sponsored projects.

You may intern in a foreign university through the student exchange programs run by VIT Pune. The department has several student bodies- IEEE and IETE student branch, E-EDC (Electronics Entrepreneurship Development Cell), and TRF(The Robotics Forum). They conduct workshops, seminars, industrial visits, and participate in competitions like ROBOCON, e-yantra, etc.

Placement-wise, ENTC is second to CS/IT. Very few core companies visit the campus, so most placements are in the IT sector. Many students get offers from foreign universities for their higher studies.
Overall, ENTC at VIT Pune is a good branch with a supportive faculty. You can consider this branch for your engineering studies.

subjects: Hostels: Separate hostels are provided to boys and girls. Girls’ hostel has a capacity of 80 students. Boys’ hostel is available for the SC/ ST/ OBC students of the district with a capacity of 80 students.

Medical Facilities: Recently, a policy named ‘Students Safety Insurance Policy’ of United India Insurance Company Limited has been introduced. The college plans to include all students under this scheme. A 16 station multi gymnasium has been installed under the supervision of a trained instructor.

Laboratories: Sophisticated and well-equipped laboratories are made available in the departments of Chemistry, Computer Science, Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, Electronics, Anthropology, Botany, Food & nutrition, Zoology.

Sports: The college provides several infrastructural sports facilities to the students. These include a playground, basketball court, volleyball court, badminton court, 16 station multi gym equipment, indoor games like table tennis, carom and chess.
Seminar Hall: The college has an air-conditioned seminar room with advance technical facilities which is used for debates, seminars, council meeting and society’s events etc.
Auditorium: There is a fully furnished 2 tier auditorium with a sitting capacity of 750.

Internet: Computer laboratories have been networked using LAN by 32/16-bit switches. The college has been provided with twenty landlines with broadband connection distributed in different departments. Ten of these have wireless modem because of which most of the lab-based departments already have a Wi-Fi enabled environment. Work is in progress to set up a separate broadband network to make the entire campus Wi-Fi enabled.

Admissions are purely based on EAMCET Rank, JEE(Mains) Rank, and intermediate marks (10+2).

A minimum of 25% marks will be required to score in EAMCET in order to make it to the merit list. Intermediate graduates with a minimum of 45% aggregate marks and (40% for SC and ST) can apply online for the exam.

In Annamacharya Institute of Technology And Sciences, one must qualify the TS-PGECET exam. The exams are in online mode. About 120 questions are asked in the exam and 25% that is 30 marks out of 120 is the minimum qualifying marks required for the general category candidates. There is no minimum cutoff mark for SC/ ST.

Vignan's Institute of Information Technology (VIIT) is a private institute established in 2002. VIIT Vishakhapatnam is ranked 201-300 in B.Tech by NIRF in 2024 out of 300 colleges in India.

VIIT offers a range of programs, including a B.Tech and M.Tech degree with eleven and eight specializations. Apart from that, the college also offers an MBA and an MCA degree course. School of Planning and Architecture (SPA) Bhopal is a government institute of architecture established in 2008 as a public institution. SPA Bhopal is recognized by the Council of Architecture (COA) and approved by AICTE. SPA Bhopal is ranked 11th by NIRF, 8th by Collegedunia in the 2025 ranking under the Architecture category. SPA Bhopal offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs.

SPA Bhopal considers different entrance exams based on the course. For admission, candidates must qualify for JEE Main, GATE, etc. SPA Bhopal Important dates for the various courses are tabulated below:

Admission to the B.Arch/B.Plan programs is based on the JEE Main (Paper 2) examination followed by JoSAA Counselling. The schedule for the JEE Main (Paper 2) exams and JoSAA Counselling are provided in the table below.
Admission to the PG programs such as M.Arch/M.Plan are based on the GATEentrance exams. The important dates for the GATE exam are provided below.

SPA Bhopal courses are offered in disciplines like Architecture and Design. SPA Bhopal courses include M.Arch, B.Arch, M.Plan, B.Plan, and M.Des. SPA Bhopal M.Arch total fee is INR 1.75 Lakhs. Students can find SPA Bhopal Course & Fee details in the table below:
Courses and Fees FAQs
Ques. Ques. How much does an international student pay per semester at SPA Bhopal?

Ans. International students at SPA Bhopal pay fees every semester under the DASA scheme. Students from non-SAARC countries pay USD 7,000 per semester, while students from SAARC countries pay USD 3,500 per semester. Students in the CIWG category (Children of Indian Workers in Gulf countries) pay about ₹62,500 per semester.
Ques. Is the hostel fee included in the total fee at SPA Bhopal?

Ans. No, the hostel fee is not included in the total fees at SPA Bhopal. Tuition and academic fees are paid separately, and students who choose hostel accommodation must pay hostel charges in addition to these fees. Mess (food) charges are also not included in the hostel fee and are paid separately.

SPA Bhopal offers admission to its various undergraduate and postgraduate programs based on scores in the national-level entrance examination. Candidates qualifying for the exam will be called for the counselling process. Students can find SPA Bhopal Admission details in the table below:
Frequently Asked Question
Ques. Is there any interview for admission at SPA Bhopal?

Ans. There is no interview for UG courses. For PG and PhD programs, students are usually required to attend an interview or physical interaction, and in some cases, submit a portfolio or appear for a written test.
Ques. How can I get admission to SPA Bhopal?

Ans. Admission to UG courses (B.Arch and B.Plan) is through JEE Main followed by JoSAA/CSAB counselling. For PG courses, admission is mainly through GATE/CEED and JAAP-PG counselling, along with an interview or interaction round.
SPA Bhopal cutoff is available for JEE Main, CSAB Counselling, and DASA here. You can check SPA Bhopal cutoff for popular courses such as B.Arch, B.Plan, and M.Plan below.
The overall cutoff rank for General Category Students and AI Quota for JEE-Main ranges between 367 and 701.
SPA Bhopal JEE Main Cutoff 2025 for the General Category and All India quota is listed below.

The overall cutoff rank for General Category Students and AI Quota for CSAB-Counselling ranges between 652 - 1696. SPA Bhopal CSAB Cutoff 2025 for the General Category and All India quota is listed below.

Many ranking agencies have ranked SPA Bhopal. SPA Bhopal Architecture ranking by NIRF is 11 out of 40 colleges in India in 2025, and it was 12 out of 40 colleges in India in 2024. The SPA Bhopal Ranking is mentioned below.
Ques. What JEE Main rank is required for B.Arch at SPA Bhopal?

Ans. The JEE Main rank needed for B.Arch at SPA Bhopal is usually between 367 and 436 for the General category. The exact cutoff can change every year depending on the number of seats, competition, and counselling.
Ques. Is there any separate cutoff for home state students at SPA Bhopal?
Ans. No, SPA Bhopal does not have a home-state quota. Admissions are done through central counselling, and cutoffs are the same for students from all states, based only on category and rank.

According to the SPA Bhopal NIRF 2025 Report, the median package for UG 4-year courses increased from INR 3 LPA in 2021-22 and 2022-23 to INR 4.8 LPA in 2023-24. UG 5-year programs also experienced growth, with the median package reaching INR 6.6 LPA in the 2023-24 academic year. The detailed SPA Bhopal placement report is as follows.
Frequently Asked Questions
Ques. Are there any internship opportunities provided for the different courses at SPA Bhopal?

Ans. Yes. SPA Bhopal is very focused on human resource development, which is why they provide a lot of hands-on field experience. Every year, summer internships are provided to students. However, these internships are not paid. But students gain a certificate of completion and a recommendation letter for excellent performance.
Ques. Is there any other training necessary during the academic session?

Ans. Yes, as part of the curricular requirements, students are required to undertake practical training in any National or International, Government or Private organization undertaking architectural works in their 4th year, 8th semester of B.Arch, for a duration of a minimum of 21 weeks.
Candidates can apply for the scholarships offered by the state or central government as per their eligibility. Below are a few of the SPA Bhopal scholarships:

SPA Bhopal is located on a 75-acre campus in Bhauri, Bhopal. The main academic building has all the departments and programs. There are separate hostels for boys and girls, and some have special wings. The campus has many facilities for both studying and living, including a material library, large studios with audio-visual tools, classrooms, a cafeteria, and a medical center with an ambulance. For sports and fitness, there are courts and fields for basketball, volleyball, badminton, football, and cricket. There is also housing for faculty and staff on the campus.
SPA Bhopal Computer Lab

SPA New Bhopal is compared with other similar architecture colleges, such as SPA Delhi and SPA Vijayawada. Below is a detailed comparison among these colleges, considering Flagship courses, first-year fees, packages, admission criteria, and rankings.
Ques. Which college should I choose for architecture, Chandigarh College of Architecture or SPA Bhopal?

Ans. One should definitely go to SPA Bhopal. SPAs are equivalent to IITs in the field of architecture. Since they are directly under the Ministry of HRD, they offer better infrastructure, facilities, and funds for students. The placement is wide and good. CCA, on the other hand, bequeaths a good name but limits itself to a niche exposure. Over the past few years, SPAs' student council has made tremendous efforts in conducting various types of activities in the college to make the college environment more energetic and happening.
Ques. How good is SPA Bhopal?

Ans. SPA Bhopal provides all kinds of basic facilities to the students. Facilities like hostel accommodation, mess, well-equipped library, practical labs, gymkhana, medical aid facilities, auditorium, and so on. A good infrastructure is provided by the college to provide students with the comfort and ease to live and study with comfort. All the basic things that are needed by a student are given to them.
Ques. How is SPA Bhopal in terms of the quality of education?

Ans. SPA Bhopal has a very qualified faculty with work experience in the relevant fields. The environment of the institution allows young minds to nurture and grow to the best of their capability so that they can learn new techniques and innovations and can cope up with the recent trends and changes in their respective fields. The school also aims to provide an area for research and new learning techniques. This college has been able to make its place in the NIRF rankings in previous years.

MSU BARODA offers biotechnology (via JNUCEEB entrance). They also provide medical biotechnology and biostatistics services. It is a government agency. Fees range between INR 18.18 K and 2.46 L. Because Amrita School of Biotechnology is a private institution, the fee structure differs. Fees range between INR 1.86 lakh and INR 2.86 lakh.

Both institutions have excellent faculty and facilities. Both institutions have a good reputation. The overall NIRF ranking of MSU is 151 whereas the Amrita School of Biotechnology is 16. Biotechnology placements are extremely rare. But after MSc from MSU, most of the students go for Ph.D. in USA / Germany / UK.
However, after earning an MSc from Amrita Vidyapitham, you must find work because you have already spent a significant amount of money. They do, however, provide good placements.

Among these, Manipal University is better for CSE. It offers good facilities to CSE students. The faculties of the department are well-experienced and cooperative. Manipal has a good placement record. Top MNCs like Microsoft, Google hire students through the campus drive.
As per the recent placement highlights, Manipal University CSE average package is around INR 7.50 LPA.

This is indeed a difficult choice to make a decision in opting for the best college among the three mentioned above since every college has its pros and cons. However, one must have a clear image and idea about the type of college you want to get admitted to and make choices accordingly that match your prerequisites.
Amrita University (Coimbatore):

The department of computer science and engineering at Amrita University Coimbatore currently offers BTech in computer science and technology and M.Tech in computer science and engineering, artificial intelligence and data science.

The department of computing at PES University (Bangalore) is meant to make globally competent manpower for the knowledge and communication technology (ICT) industry with an optimal mixture of fundamental theory subjects and practical, current, and industry-relevant subjects.

Marathwada Mitramandal's College of Commerce Pune, also known as MMCC Pune, is a private, autonomous institute established in 1967. It is affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University, SPPU, Pune, and is approved by AICTE, New Delhi. MMCC Pune is accredited Grade A by NAAC and is named under some of the popular colleges for affordable commercial studies in Pune. MMCC Pune offers admission in 3 Undergraduate courses, 2 Postgraduate courses, 1 Postgraduate diploma, 7 Certificate courses, and a Phd program.

BBA is the flagship course at MMCC Pune. The college offers BBA first-year fees at INR 51,545 - 53,540 in 3 specializations, namely General, International Business, and Computer Applications. To get admission at MMCC Pune, you have to appear in the MHT-CET CAP Counselling for BBA admissions. For all the other courses at MMCC Pune, the institute accepts direct applications based on merit.

MMCC Pune placement 2024–2025 report has not yet been released. According to the latest released MMCC Pune placement data from the 2023-2024 academic year, the total number of students placed was 68 across all courses at MMCC Pune. The highest salary package offered at MMCC Pune was 8.40 LPA and the average salary package offered was between 2.8 - 3.0 LPA. Some of the top industry recruiters taking part in the MMCC Pune placement drives are Cognizant, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, IBM, Dell, Capgemini, Honeywell, Accenture, Havells, Bajaj Allianz

Ques. Does MMCC Pune have a dress code?

Ans. Yes, MMCC Pune has a dress code. It is mandatory for students to wear the uniform on campus on days designated by the college authorities. On days it's not mandatory to wear the uniform, students can wear formal.
Ques. Can I take direct admission into MMCC Pune?
Ans. Yes, direct admission is the primary admission process for all the courses at MCC Pune except BBA. For BBA, it is mandatory for students to appear into MHT-CET.
Ques. Which university is the MMCC Pune affiliated with?
Ans. MMCC Pune is affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) and is approved by AICTE, New Delhi.
Ques. What is the contact information of MMCC Pune?
Ans. MMCC Pune contact information is as follows:
Ques. What are the MMCC Pune transport facilities available around the campus for students?
Ans. MMCC Pune is about 2.7 km away from the Shivajinagar Railway Station and quite close to the Deccan Metro.
Ques. Is MMCC Pune a minority institution?
Ans. No, MMCC Pune is a co-educational, private and non-minority institution located in the city of Pune, Maharashtra.
Ques. What are the office hours of MMCC Pune?
Ans. The office timings for MMCC Pune are between 10:00 AM - 4:30 PM.
Ques. Is MMCC Pune Co-ed?
Ans. MMCC Pune is a private, self-financed, non-minority and Co-Educational institution.
Ques: What student clubs and extracurricular activities do MMCC Pune have?
Ans: Sports, Yoga, Arts and Crafts competitions, Awareness programs, guest lectures, fests, and cultural events happen at MMCC Pune.
Ques: what is the infrastructure present in MMCC Pune?
Ans. Central Library, Staff room, Boys hostel, Student associations, IT Labs, Canteen, Green Campus, Seminar Halls, Gymnasium etc are some of the features of the infrastructure present at MMCC Pune.

Ques: Is CET Trivandrum a government college?

Ans. CET Trivandrum is a government engineering college, established in 1939 by the Government of Travancore. This institute is acknowledged and managed by the Government of Kerala. It is affiliated with APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University. As a government institution, it receives various funding and economic support from the state government and sticks to its regulations set by the educational ministries.
Ques. When does the admission process start?

Ans. The admission process at the CET begins in the first quarter of the year, but it depends on the program. For UG courses such as B.Tech and B.Arch, the admissions start in February with KEAM registration. For PG admissions like M.Tech and M.Arch, the admission starts right after GATE results, which are usually released their results in May, through CCMT. For admission to an MBA, it starts around April, based on CAT, CMAT, or KMAT scores.
Ques. What extracurricular activities are available at CET?

Ans. CET offers a vast range of extracurricular activities, which are held by various student clubs and societies. These extracurricular activities include technical clubs like RoboCET, AeroCET, the Coding Club, and the Google Developer Student Club. As for the cultural groups, such as the Music Club, Dance Club, and Film Club. Many of the Students can also engage in the Quiz Club, Literary Society, and AstroCET for astronomy enthusiasts.

Biomedical engineering isn't a simple field to tackle. Before you enroll, make sure to look into the faculty, lab, and library resources at the institute. This field is largely research-focused, and with medical sciences advancing rapidly, it's crucial to keep updating your knowledge.

Although SSN is newer compared to CIT, it consistently provides excellent facilities for its students. It's a good idea to visit the campuses or talk to current students before making your decision. Remember, just having a degree might not be enough to make it in the biomedical industry.

Honestly, I wouldn't suggest joining SSN College. Don't get swayed by the big campus, trees, and fountains; it can be misleading. I regret choosing this college based on recommendations from people who weren't even part of it. I'm currently a 3rd-year EEE student here, so I have some insights that others might not deny.

The teaching staff mostly have degrees just for the sake of it and often lack proper teaching skills. We frequently had to turn to our seniors for help with subjects, which is fine, but you need to be cautious with your behavior to avoid any form of ragging. There are a few good teachers, but overall, you might find better teaching elsewhere.

Lab equipment, especially in the computer labs, often malfunctions, and it can take a long time to get fixed. This makes it hard for students to grasp concepts, and at those times, we are left with just books to memorize.

Some faculty members discreetly provide students with exam questions from Anna University, making it easy to pass exams, but this neglects actual learning. If your goal is just to get a degree, SSN might work for you. However, if you aim to become a competent engineer, you should consider other colleges.

While I’ve heard from graduated seniors that placements are decent, the placement fees are hefty. It might take you up to five years to recover from the financial strain, even with a good job. If your family is financially comfortable, then it might not be an issue for you.

SSN used to have a strong reputation before 2010, but it's not the same now. People often think it’s still great due to the large campus and placement opportunities, but the quality of education and lab facilities has declined significantly. Many rely on outdated reviews or opinions from those who aren’t aware of the current situation.

Moreover, the technology is outdated. Alumni have mentioned struggling in IT jobs because SSN doesn’t keep up with new programming languages, software, and industrial tools. For example, some computers still run an old version of Windows 10, and although Python is introduced in the first year, it’s not effectively integrated in later years. If you're considering ECE, CSE, or IT, there are certainly better options.

To sum up, if you’re looking to become a skilled engineer without unnecessary struggles, SSN might not be the right choice. People often judge a college by its appearance and placement stats, thinking SSN is as good as it was pre-2010.
However, if money isn't a concern and you're planning to join your family business or enter fields where a degree is just a formality, SSN could be suitable for you. In that case, go for it.

P.S. Some reviews online might show SSN in a positive light. Some of these might be valid but outdated, while others could be from uninformed parents or students who are there just to have fun rather than study.

Ques. Is there a direct admission option at IIBS Bangalore?

Ans. Yes, the International Institute of Business Studies (IIBS) Bangalore offers a direct admission option for candidates with valid scores in national-level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, and GMAT. Candidates who meet the minimum academic requirement of 50% at graduation are usually directly called for the group discussion and personal interview rounds. These rounds assess a candidate’s communication skills, problem-solving ability, and overall personality, ensuring admission is granted to those who are best suited for the program.
Ques. Where are the group discussion and personal interview rounds conducted for IIBS Bangalore admissions?

Ans. The GD and PI rounds for shortlisted candidates are conducted at multiple cities across India. Some of the test locations include Bangalore, Pune, NCR, Allahabad, Patna, Ranchi, Jaipur, Hyderabad, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Bhopal, Indore, Srinagar, Kanpur, Varanasi, Gorakhpur, Agra, Hissar, Chandigarh, Dhanbad, Jodhpur, Bikaner, Panji, Raipur, Bhilai, Chennai, Cochin, Ahmedabad, and Agartala. Candidates can choose the most convenient city while applying.
Ques. How can I reach IIBS Bangalore?

Ans. IIBS Bangalore is situated close to Kempegowda International Airport. The campus is easily reachable by taxi, cab services, or BMTC buses. The nearest railway station is Yelahanka, which is approximately 20-25 minutes away from the campus.
Ques. Which banks offer education loans, and what are the student credit card schemes available for IIBS Bangalore students?

Ans. Students of IIBS Business School can apply for education loans through tie-up banks like SBI, Bank of Baroda, IDBI Bank, and Axis Bank, as well as any other nationalised bank. SBI provides a collateral-free loan of up to INR 7.5 lakhs.

Students can also avail themselves of state-specific student credit card schemes: the Guruji Student Credit Card (GSCC) for Jharkhand students, the West Bengal Student Credit Card Scheme, and the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme for students of their respective states.
Ques. What international opportunities are available for IIBS students, including exchange programs, boot camps, and other benefits?

Ans. Only the top 50 MBA students and top 50 PGDM students from the Bengaluru campus are eligible for the international tour. Eligibility requires at least 80% overall attendance, 85% attendance in the Finishing School, and strong academic performance in the ongoing course. These students can also participate in the International Student Exchange Programme (Italy, Switzerland, Singapore, Dubai, Malaysia, and the UK) and yearly International Boot Camps (Italy, Australia, France, Japan, the USA, Malaysia, and the UK). Eligible students also receive a free laptop.

School of Planning and Architecture (SPA) Vijayawada, established by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, in 2008 through an Act of Parliament. It is a centrally funded autonomous institute. The college has been ranked 10th by Collegedunia and 19th by NIRF in the 2025 ranking under the Architecture category. SPA Vijayawada offers courses at the UG, PG, and PhD levels.

SPA Vijayawada considers different entrance exams based on the course. For admission, candidates must qualify for JEE Main, GATE, and other exams. SPA Vijayawada Important dates for the various courses are tabulated below:

Admission to the B.Arch/B.Plan programs are based on the JEE Main (Paper 2) examination followed by JoSAA Counselling. The schedule for the JEE Main (Paper 2) exams and JoSAA Counselling is provided in the table below.
Admission to the PG programs such as M.Arch / M.Plan / M.E.M. / M.Des are based on the GATE/CEED entrance exams. The important dates for the GATE and CEED exam are provided below.
Ques. What are the reporting and document verification dates at SPA Vijayawada?

Ans. Once you are allotted a seat in JoSAA counselling, SPA Vijayawada releases a reporting schedule for document verification. This usually happens within a few days of the seat allotment results. Students need to go to the campus or follow the online process, fill out all the required documents, pay the admission fee, and complete other formalities.
Ques. If I miss the JoSAA admission deadline for SPA Vijayawada, is there any chance later in the process?

Ans. Yes, in many cases. For B.Arch / B.Plan admissions, later CSAB rounds often open opportunities due to seat withdrawals. Similarly, PG programs may have spot rounds or institute-level rounds if seats remain vacant, so regularly checking the official SPA Vijayawada website is strongly recommended.

SPA Vijayawada offers various UG, PG, and Doctorate level in the Architecture and Design departments. The total fee of the most popular B.Arch program is INR 4.8 Lakhs. For each year, the tuition fee of INR 95,000 is charged. Hostel fees are charged separately. Here is the detailed table of SPA Vijayawada Courses & Fees:

Note: All fees and payments mentioned are for one academic year. The hostel fee includes an annual seat rent of INR 10,000, which day scholars also need to pay. The hostel security deposit applies only to hostel students and is not required for day scholars. Mess fees are extra and must be paid as per the Mess Committee’s instructions. Students admitted through DASA must pay tuition fees separately, which are announced every year on the DASA website.
Ques. What are the specialisations provided under the postgraduate degree at SPA Vijayawada?

Ans. At the postgraduate level, SPA Vijayawada offers several specialisations in architecture and planning. These include M.Arch in Sustainable Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Architectural Conservation, and Urban Design, M.Plan in Urban and Regional Planning, Environmental Planning and Management, and Transportation and Infrastructure Planning, along with a Master’s degree in Building Engineering and Management.
Ques. Is SPA Vijayawada worth the fees charged?

Ans. Yes, SPA Vijayawada is worth the fees charged. It is a central government institute and an Institute of National Importance, so the fees are much lower than most private architecture colleges. Students get good academic exposure, experienced faculty, and a strong reputation in the architecture and planning fields.

SPA Vijayawada is open for UG, PG and PhD admissions. It currently offers various courses, including B.Arch, M.Arch, PhD, M.Plan, B.Plan, M.E.M., and MUD. Admission to the B.Arch program is based on the JEE Main rank, followed by JoSAA / CSAB / DASA counselling. Here is the detailed table of SPA Vijayawada Admission:
Ques. How are DASA/NRI students admitted at SPA Vijayawada?

Ans. Students applying through the DASA scheme (for NRI/PIO/foreign students) are required to submit JEE Main Paper-2 scores and pay the DASA tuition fees, which are separate from regular SPA fees. They must apply online through the DASA portal before the deadline. SPA Vijayawada reserves a specific number of seats for DASA applicants, and admission is strictly merit-based according to the JEE Main Paper-2.
Ques. Does SPA Vijayawada accept state quota admissions?

Ans. No, SPA Vijayawada does not accept state quota admissions. It is a central government institute, so all seats are filled through the All India Quota only. There is no home-state or Andhra Pradesh quota, and students from all states compete on the same national merit list.
Ques. Are there age limits for UG admissions?

Ans. Yes. For UG programs like B.Arch and B.Plan, candidates usually must be under 25 years old on the date mentioned in the admission notice. Some age relaxations may be given for SC/ST/OBC categories, as notified by SPA Vijayawada.

A Thriving Campus Life: MIT is not just about academics; it's a vibrant hub of opportunities. You must join student clubs, including technical ones, to explore your passions beyond the classroom.
Sports Galore: If you're a sports enthusiast, you're in for a treat! MIT boasts semi-professional cricket and football teams, guaranteeing an adrenaline-packed experience and fierce competition.

Culinary Delights: When it comes to food, Manipal has you covered. With two fantastic Mexican restaurants and a variety of options, you'll rarely be disappointed by the gastronomic adventures you can embark on. Plus, the college mess is a cut above the rest, making sure you're well-fed and satisfied.

Balancing Recreation: It's true that Manipal is known for its lively social scene. While temptations are around, remember that your choices are what matter most. Find the right balance between academics and recreation to enjoy a fulfilling college experience.

Supportive Faculty: The professors at MIT, especially in Mechanical and Civil engineering, are both knowledgeable and approachable. While the education system may focus on achieving high marks, you'll have experts to guide you along the way.

Placements and Beyond While placements have their challenges, MIT provides you with the tools to shine in higher studies. It's an excellent choice if you aspire to continue your education and build a strong foundation for future success.

Sir JJ College of Architecture, Mumbai, is a government-aided institution established in 1857. It is one of India’s oldest architecture colleges. The college is affiliated with the University of Mumbai and approved by the Council of Architecture (COA) and All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). It is ranked 8th by India Today and 29th by IIRF among architecture colleges in India in 2025. The college offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs, including B.Arch and M.Arch.

Sir JJ College of Architecture is known for its B.Arch course, a 5-year program, and M.Arch, a 2-year program. The B.Arch first-year fee is INR 18,584. Sir JJ College Of Architecture admission to B.Arch is based on JEE Main (Paper-II), NATA, or MHT CET scores, followed by State-level counseling by the Maharashtra State CET Cell. M.Arch admission requires a B.Arch degree and a valid MAH-M.Arch-CET score.

As per student reviews, starting salaries are usually between INR 50,000 to 2 lakh per month. Big companies like L&T, Eros Group, DLF, and Sahara Group have come to the college mainly to hire interns.
Here are the key highlights of Sir JJ College Of Architecture Mumbai

Sir JJ College Of Architecture Courses and Fees 2025
Sir JJ College of Architecture offers degree courses in architecture at the UG and PG levels. The Sir JJ College of Architecture courses details are shared below:

The Sir JJ College of Architecture (SJJCA), Mumbai, offers B.Arch and M.Arch courses. For B.Arch, candidates need a 10+2 qualification with at least 50% aggregate (45% for reserved categories), and admission is based on scores from JEE Main (Paper-II), NATA, or MHT CET, followed by state counseling. For M.Arch, a B.Arch degree is required, with admission through MAH-M.Arch-CET. The application process involves downloading forms from the official website or visiting the admission office, with no direct admissions available. The course-wise details table for Sir JJ College of Architecture Admissions, including eligibility and selection criteri,a is shared below.

As per reviews posted by students on Collegedunia, Placements at Sir JJ College of Architecture Mumbai are okay, but not very strong. Some students said the college’s placement cell tries hard and many companies come for pool hiring. Still, most seniors either got average jobs or went for higher studies.

Other students shared that the college does not give placements directly — they have to apply on their own, though studying here does help them get noticed. Many students find jobs in areas like railways, city planning, and government departments. Common roles include project architect, architecture teacher, building inspector, and technician.
Starting salaries are usually between INR 50,000 to 2 lakh per month. Big companies like L&T, Eros Group, DLF, and Sahara Group have come to the college mainly to hire interns.
Sir JJ College of Architecture is compared with two of its biggest competitor colleges in the architecture category in Mumbai in the table below:

Sir JJ College of Architecture is located in Mumbai. It has a big campus that it shares with Sir JJ School of Art. The campus has many old buildings with beautiful designs. The main building itself is over 100 years old and is an example of classic architecture.

The college has well-equipped studios where students work on their design projects. There are separate classrooms for theory subjects. The college also has a library with many books on architecture, design, and history. Students can use these books to study and prepare for their work.There are computer labs with design software which help students learn modern tools used in architecture.
The college also has a material museum that shows samples of different building materials. This helps students understand how different materials look and feel.

Students often work on models, sketches, and drawings. For this, the college provides drafting tables and model-making spaces. There is also a workshop where students can learn how to handle tools and make small structures.

The campus has open areas where students can sit, discuss, and relax. It also has a small canteen that serves food and tea. The college hosts events, exhibitions, and workshops from time to time. These activities give students a chance to show their work and learn from experts.
Overall, the campus provides the basic facilities needed for architecture studies in a peaceful environment in the middle of a busy city like Mumbai.

A recent review posted on Collegedunia in 2024 talks about the campus life “We have no annual and technical fests in our college. We have a library in our college which consists of a variety of books and reference books. We have a sports fest and a variety of clubs and teams in our college”. Read the full review
Ques. How is the transport connectivity for Sir JJ College Of Architecture?

Ans. Sir JJ College of Architecture is located in Fort, Mumbai, a well-connected area. Students can easily reach the college by train, with Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) and Churchgate stations nearby. Local buses and auto-rickshaws are available for short distances. The college is close to major roads, making taxi and ride-sharing services like Ola and Uber accessible. Mumbai’s metro system also has stations nearby, such as Marine Lines, providing quick travel options. Shivajirao Kadam Institute of Technology & Management (SKITM), Indore has a compact campus with basic academic and residential facilities for students.
Ques. How is SKITM Indore campus life according to students?

Ans. Student discussions and reviews suggest that campus life at SKITM Indore is fairly simple, disciplined, and academically focused rather than highly modern or premium in experience. Attendance rules and class schedules are taken seriously, so students need to maintain regularity in academics. At the same time, the overall environment is manageable, with normal student interaction, events, and routine activities that make day-to-day life balanced but not overly relaxed.
Ques. How are placements at SKITM Indore in reality?

Ans. Based on student feedback, placements at SKITM Indore are considered average, with better outcomes mainly in CSE, IT, and related branches. Companies do visit the campus for recruitment, including IT service firms and some core companies, but final placement results depend heavily on individual skills, coding ability, aptitude, and interview preparation. Many students also prepare off-campus or improve skills through internships to secure better opportunities.
Ques. Is SKITM Indore a good option for engineering?

Ans. Student opinions are mixed, but most agree that SKITM Indore is a suitable choice for students looking for affordable private engineering education. It provides basic academic structure and exposure to engineering fundamentals, but it may not offer the same level of exposure, brand value, or placement opportunities as top-tier institutes. It is generally preferred by students who want a cost-effective engineering degree with steady academic support.
Ques. How is faculty and academics at SKITM Indore?

Ans. As per student experiences, faculty at SKITM Indore is generally supportive and approachable, especially for academic doubts and internal exams. Teaching quality may vary across departments, but regular lectures, assignments, and internal assessments are conducted in a structured manner. The academic system is fairly disciplined, ensuring students stay consistent with studies and syllabus completion.
Ques. What is the overall student opinion about SKITM Indore?

Ans. Overall student feedback indicates that SKITM Indore is a decent private engineering college with moderate infrastructure, average placements, and a structured academic environment. It is seen as a practical option for students who prioritize affordability and local accessibility over high-end exposure or top-tier placement outcomes. The experience largely depends on individual effort, skills, and how actively students engage in additional learning outside academics.

subject_lists.title: TSAP Mumbai Admission Process
subjects: The "Online Application Form" is available to only those eligible candidates, who are desirous of seeking admission to the colleges through this admission process on the official website viz. www.dte.org.in

Aspiring candidates are required to fill in the online application form, take the printout of it and submit it in person along with duly signed printout of the online application form, required documents (both originals & attested copies) at the Application Form Receipt Center (ARC)

The Merit List of eligible candidates for Centralized Admission Process (CAP) will be displayed on the website. There are a total of four CAP rounds. The site mentions the dates for each of the procedures given in the following steps:
Go to the website www.dte.org.in/arch. Fill the form and then take its printout.
Go to your nearest ARC and submit the form. They will give a STAMPED printout of the form
On the specified dates, go to the ARC with the documents mentioned (original and attested copy) and the stamped printout which you have.

Check out the provisional merit list displayed on the site and ensure that all your details are correctly specified in the list. If there is any discrepancy, then go to the ARC on the specified dates and get it corrected.
Check out the final merit list displayed along with your rank.

Go to the website and fill the online option form according to your choice. You can fill up to a maximum of 10 preferences. You have to report to the ARC in person and confirm the submission of your online option form
Provisional allotment list is then displayed on the site.
If you have been allotted a seat, then report to the particular college. You are not eligible for further CAP rounds and have to compulsorily take admission in that particular college.
An Institute vacancy list is displayed on the site after each CAP round.
If you have not been allotted a seat, then you can fill another option form online. Repeat the same procedure from step ‘9’ to ‘11’ for CAP round 2.
Now if you still haven’t got a seat, then repeat steps '9' to '11' for CAP round 3.
Even after round 3, if you haven’t got a seat then there is another CAP round
These CAP rounds (NATA) are applicable for colleges all over Maharashtra.

Thakur School of Architecture and Planning (TSAP) is a private college established in the year 2014. The institute meets both the local and global requirements of Architecture by providing “State of the Art Architectural Education” to aspiring architects. TSAP is approved by the Council of Architecture (COA), the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), and the Govt. of Maharashtra. It is affiliated to the University of Mumbai and is an unaided and Hindi linguistic minority institute.

TSAP has been awarded the “Architecture College of the year” award by Higher Education Digest 2023 and is also awarded the “Top Architecture Institute” in Times Survey for the fourth consecutive year. In addition, TSAP was also awarded as the “Best Institution of Architecture” in Mumbai by the Times of India.

TSAP Mumbai offers undergraduate courses in the field of Architecture and designing, namely B.Arch and B.Voc. It provides world-class infrastructural facilities like vast spaces that promote architectural education, intensive industry facilities, academia interactions, international collaborations, intra and intra disciplinary learning, in-school practicals – managing architecture, study by research, intensive faculty-student interaction that promotes innovations, and intense research and developments. This is done by exposing the students to international experts in the field, hosting and presenting papers at national and international conferences, workshops, symposiums, seminars, design fests, and through active design & research base.
TSAP also provides good placement opportunities and the highest and average package reported in 2024 placements is INR 3,21,588 XS CAD India Pvt. Ltd. and INR 1,80,000 respectively.

Rajagiri College of Social Sciences (Autonomous) has been ranked the second cleanest higher educational institution in the country in the Swachh Campus Ranking 2019 conducted by the Ministry of Human Resource Development as part of the Swachh Bharat Mission of the Government of India.

Rajagiri College of social science was ranked seventh in the country and first in the State in India’s Top Ranked Private Autonomous Colleges Category in 2022-23 & 2020 -21 and was ranked eighth in the country and first in the State in India’s Top Ranked Private Autonomous Colleges Category in 2021-22. Ques. Is Mount Carmel College fully co-ed now?

Ans. Mount Carmel College was originally a women’s college, but now it offers co-ed programs mainly at the postgraduate level and in a few professional courses. Most undergraduate programs are still primarily for women, so the campus is still largely female-dominant.
Ques. Is attendance and discipline very strict at Mount Carmel College, Bangalore?

Ans. From what many seniors share, attendance at Mount Carmel College is taken quite seriously. Regular class participation is expected, and students who frequently miss lectures may find that it affects their internal assessments or practical marks. However, the level of strictness can vary slightly across departments and professors. That said, students who actively participate in college activities such as fests, clubs, competitions, or departmental events often mention that professors tend to be understanding, provided they communicate in advance. Maintaining reasonable attendance and staying responsible with academic commitments usually helps avoid any issues.
Ques. Are hostel seats limited at Mount Carmel College, Bangalore?

Ans. Yes, hostel accommodation at Mount Carmel College is limited. Because many students apply from outside Bangalore, the available hostel rooms usually fill up quickly after admissions begin. Students who need on-campus accommodation are generally advised to apply for the hostel as early as possible after confirming their admission to improve their chances of getting a seat.
Ques. How good is the crowd at Mount Carmel? Is it very competitive?

Ans. As per students and peers, the crowd is quite diverse. There are people from Bangalore, other states, and sometimes even international students. Academically strong students are definitely there, but the competition usually becomes noticeable during internships, leadership roles in clubs, or when preparing for higher studies. Many seniors say the environment pushes people to become more confident and independent.

For students in CSE or ECE, placement opportunities are abundant, with nearly everyone getting placed.
Salaries range from 6 to 14 lakhs, depending on skills.
However, for branches like Mechanical, Civil, or EEE, placements are fewer, with about 40% securing jobs.
Non-circuit branches have fewer placements compared to circuit ones.
JNTUH is one of the top colleges in Telangana, aside from BITS and IIT Hyderabad.
The curriculum is well-structured, with schedules and exams planned in advance.
Some professors are very skilled, while others are average.
First-year syllabuses are completed on time, and some teachers offer extra sessions.
Students are encouraged to learn independently through resources like NPTEL and YouTube.
The first-year hostel has strict anti-ragging rules.
There's also an international hostel for students from countries like Nepal and Africa, offering 2 BHK flats shared among 2-3 students for ?6000 monthly, excluding food.
The campus has two libraries, including a digital one with fast internet and access to paid journals.
A new sports complex offers facilities like a gym and courts for various sports, with cricket tournaments held between branches.
Financial help from TEQUIP is available for research and projects, and students can attend free courses at IIT for 1-2 weeks.
Fees are quite affordable at ?10,000 for BTech and ?35,000 for IDP, with scholarships for economically weaker and meritorious students.
There is no dress code, allowing students to wear casuals and enjoy a lot of freedom.
Internship opportunities are mostly for CSE and IT students.
The syllabus doesn't always match industry needs.
There's no strong alumni network, and convocation is only for department toppers.
Career guidance is lacking, and there's no bus service for day scholars.
A minimum of 75% attendance is required.
The college could benefit from more advanced labs, better playgrounds, and more field trips and industrial visits for practical learning.
Additional facilities like a swimming pool and gym inside the sports complex would be beneficial.
The entire campus is equipped with Wi-Fi, which is fantastic for e-learning. If you use it wisely, it can be really beneficial.
The university, e-library, and college libraries have an extensive selection of books and e-magazines. They also offer resources for competitive exams, which is quite helpful.
There's a centralized computer center that's open all day, every day, which I found incredibly useful.
The labs get the job done.

Most placements are in the software sector. If you're looking to work in fields like civil, mechanical, chemical, metallurgy, or electronics, you might struggle to find a job in your area through campus placements.
There's no proper communication system like student emails. We live in a tech-savvy world, but beyond Wi-Fi, there isn't much innovation here. It feels quite outdated.

The campus rules are quite strict. If you're anywhere near the girls' hostel, the security guards will yell at you as if you're breaking some major rule. It's surprising to see such strict regulations in a leading institute.
I couldn't find an NPTEL local chapter or any push for smart learning. The internet mainly gets used for social media instead of educational purposes.
There aren't any art clubs, dance groups, literary events, or NCC activities. Mostly, it's just small disputes between different departments.

JNTU College of Engineering has a pretty poor reputation. During the pandemic, while some universities showed understanding and flexibility with fees and exams, JNTU-H didn't seem to care much. Other places allowed students to pay fees in installments and gave more time to study for exams. But JNTU-H, named after Nehru, didn't really make any efforts like that.

Even before the pandemic, they didn’t consider any religious festivals, and last semester, many students who usually scored well ended up with surprisingly low marks because the grading wasn't done properly. Since September, their online classes have been rushed, like trying to squeeze a full semester into a short time. And for labs, they expect students to complete lab records without actually attending practical sessions. There are just a lot of issues to point out with this university.

I’m currently pursuing my Bachelor of Technology in Cyber Security at JNTU Hyderabad, and I find the curriculum to be quite relevant to current industry needs. The exams are structured well, with two midterms and a semester exam, allowing us enough time to prepare. The faculty is friendly and mostly helpful, although the teaching methods could improve to be more interactive.

For placements, students become eligible from the 6th semester, and the highest package has been 52 lakhs, so there are good opportunities if you work hard. The campus life is vibrant, with various clubs and activities, which makes studying here enjoyable.

I spent two years glued to my phone, one year playing cricket, and just a few days hitting the books. My four years were all about having fun. Staying in the hostel was a blast with my friends. We went on bike rides and trips, creating lots of happy and a few sad memories.

Being surrounded by a lively group of friends made time fly by. Semesters seemed to start quickly, but slowed down when exams and practicals came around. Studying wasn't a big focus; we’d have all-nighters before exams, with someone breaking down the entire syllabus overnight.
Festivals brought even more excitement. Teasing juniors and giving them a hard time was amusing. Finishing my B.Tech was bittersweet because I had to leave all of that behind.

I really miss those moments: the playful banter from Kulai and Ram, Yerra Sai's laid-back attitude during cricket, Akhil's intensity, Aman's kind words, Vamsi's bowling skills, Tejasai's powerful hits, Nikhil's wild antics, Ravi's random thoughts, Som's innocence, Dharma's big appetite, and my favorite thing, wicket keeping.

As of February 2018, here are some positives I noticed:
Now, for some of the downsides: I chose this college because it's one of the best in the state, but a few things let me down.

Studying Computer Science and Engineering at JNTU Hyderabad has been quite a mixed bag for me. The curriculum is relevant to current industry needs, but sometimes I feel it's not as hands-on as it could be. The exams are conducted every semester, and they are moderately difficult.

I've heard from seniors that the placements are good, with many companies coming to hire students. The average package is about 4-5 LPA, which is decent for a government college.
