TAPMI Manipal is ranked among the top 20 business schools in India. It boasts prestigious international accreditations like AACSB (2012, 2017) and AMBA (2018). It also holds an A*** rating from CRISIL at both national and state levels. TAPMI provides AICTE-approved courses and is accredited by the NBA. Its postgraduate programs are recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) as equivalent to MBA degrees.

Since 2019, TAPMI has updated its admission process, which now includes a Group Discussion and Critical Incident Interview focusing on candidates' behavior. They look for traits like self-management, empathy, achievement orientation, and teamwork. Faculty members have received special training to conduct these sessions effectively.

Getting into TAPMI isn't too hard. You generally need about an 85 percentile if your degree isn't in BTech. For BTech grads, especially those from companies like Infosys, TCS, Wipro, or CTS, a bit of uniqueness can help your case as they value diversity. A little confidence and a decent profile can make a big difference!

Life at TAPMI, especially in the MBA program, is quite rigorous. The curriculum is demanding, with multiple subjects and projects each trimester. It’s a bit overwhelming at times, but it definitely prepares you for the corporate world. The faculty is really supportive and approachable, which helps when you're struggling with the workload. Plus, the placement record is impressive, with 100% placements and packages going up to 25 LPA. Overall, while it can be stressful, the environment is conducive to growth and learning.
Going anonymous to keep things unbiased and avoid any backlash

TAPMI has definitely upped its game over the past few years. Situated in Manipal, a student-friendly town, this college is really making its mark. The campus is quite a sight! Let me break it down for you.

Infrastructure: The campus looks great, with classrooms that are above average compared to many other business schools. The library and computer lab are well-equipped, but there's no auditorium, so students head into town for larger gatherings. Hostel rooms are basic, not luxury but not bad either. The food in the mess is hit or miss, with some quality issues—once, over 100 students got sick from spoiled daal. Mess charges aren't in the fees, and buying from different vendors can get pricey.

Sports facilities are just okay. There's a cricket field, but it often floods because of the heavy rains in Manipal. Overall, the infrastructure is solid, and classes are split into two shifts to fit everyone in.
Faculty: The teaching staff is pretty average. A few stand out as excellent, but some don't handle criticism well. The administration is strict and not too student-friendly.

Rules and Regulations: Rules are a big deal here. TAPMI is firm with them. Getting permission to go home or for a night out involves a lot of paperwork, making you rethink the whole idea. Curfew is strict, holidays are few, dress codes can be annoying, and missing out on placements is a real threat they follow through on.

Campus Life: You can hang out with friends on campus for as long as you want. There are some festivals and activities, but they're not as exciting compared to other colleges. Joining inter-college competitions is tough because faculty prioritize attendance.
City Life: Manipal is a small town with a few pubs and bars, nothing extravagant. There are some nearby eateries, but not much else going on. That doesn't bother me much though.
Crowd: Most students are GEM, with many from the South; not as many from the North. It's quite a diverse mix.

Placements: Here's the big topic. There's a 100% placement rate, but the average figures, especially for summer placements, are a bit exaggerated. Everyone gets internships, though not all are paid. Job profiles are average, and the location is a downside during placements. However, the placement committee works really hard. The large batch size is a challenge for placements.

Ranking: Don't rely too much on rankings; they can be misleading. Competitors are FORE and GIM. FORE has an edge due to its location, which helps during placements. TAPMI is a tier-two school, with location and batch size as major challenges. Schools like IMT, XIMB, IMI, and IRMA are a step above.
Alumni: TAPMI has some notable alumni, including CFOs and CMOs, and a strong alumni network.

Overall, TAPMI has decent infrastructure, reasonable fees (though mess and electricity charges are extra), and good placements given its location and ranking—but keep your expectations realistic. The faculty is just okay, and some societies are more about boosting your resume than actual involvement. The quizzing culture isn't strong, and metro cities do better in that regard. Management can be overly strict, which can be a problem if it becomes counterproductive. The location is a bit remote, with the nearest airport in Mangalore, requiring a taxi to Manipal that costs over 1300. In my opinion, location and batch size are key factors for tier-two colleges, and TAPMI falls short in these areas.

I wouldn't recommend going for a tier-two college if you're taking out a loan; it might be better to try the CAT exam again. If you have a high CAT score, you might qualify for a scholarship at TAPMI, but I'm not sure if that would be your top choice.
I hope this gives you a clear and fair picture.

I would say TAPMI has its own charm, especially in the MBA program. The faculty here are well-qualified, and the learning experience is great. The placement rate is 100%, and they have good companies visiting, like Deloitte and ITC. The average package is around 14.6 lakh, which is decent. I haven’t been to IIM, but from what I hear, they have their own advantages. TAPMI might not have the same brand recognition as IIM, but it’s definitely competitive in its own right.

1. If you're deciding based on financial returns after a PGDM, staying in your current job might be better unless you get into an IIM. As an engineer with 3-4 years of experience, you can earn around 8-10 lakh per year. Spending 12-14 lakh on an MBA for an average package of 9-10 lakh annually might not be the best financial move.
2. Many graduates end up in IT roles like business analysts or consultants, which are also available to engineering grads.

3. TAPMI isn't as recognized in the corporate world as some other schools like IMT, XIMB, or GIM. Even people in your office or locals in Karnataka might not know much about it, despite it being around for 30 years.
4. Indian MBA programs need to update their courses to include current trends like mobility, data science, and digital marketing.

5. A bachelor's degree often suffices to show your skills and succeed. If you're really interested in marketing or finance, you can learn from books. Many MBA students seem more focused on getting a job and a degree than on actual learning.
6. An MS from a foreign university might be a better choice if you're looking at ROI and degree value, as they're often more respected by Indian companies.

With 2-5 years of IT experience, pursuing an MBA at TAPMI could be beneficial. The course is intensive, with a mix of practical and theoretical learning. Companies like Deloitte and ITC come for placements, with the highest package reported at 25 lakhs. The fees are around 21.6 lakhs, including hostel costs, which is quite a bit, but the 100% placement rate makes it an appealing option. So, if you're ready for a challenge and want to grow, TAPMI could be a great fit.

TAPMI was truly a place where I experienced "Learning for Life". There were tons of options to get involved in, like sports, committee activities, college competitions, and industry meetups. Personally, I focused on taking full advantage of these opportunities.

Being there made me tougher and taught me how to handle tough situations effectively. The infrastructure is quite impressive, with well-equipped hostel rooms, classrooms, a library, wi-fi, computer labs, and a finance lab.
In the past year, the management has made some great improvements. I'm really pleased with my decision to choose TAPMI over other schools I considered after the entrance exams.

For the PGDM program, TAPMI is a solid choice among Tier-3 colleges. It has a steady track record in the job market. If you're into marketing, it shines in that area, offering good profiles. It's a reliable choice, but you should also weigh it against any other offers you have.

I can't list all 50, but I can mention some top colleges in AP that accept EAMCET scores. If you've got a good rank and are anywhere in the state, VIT-AP and SRM-AP come highly recommended. For those located in Krishna or Guntur districts, VRSEC, RVRJC, VVIT, Vignan, and LBRCE are solid choices. Beyond these, I'm not too familiar with others, but some well-known ones are AU, JNTUK, SRKR in Bhimavaram, MITS, SVU in Tirupati, Gayatri in Vizag, and VIT Bhimavaram. Hope this helps, and good luck!

subjects: Mount Carmel College offers a good ROI overall, especially for PG courses due to lower fees.
B.Com and BBA provide better returns because of strong placement opportunities in finance and management roles.
Science courses have a moderate ROI but improve with specialisation and higher studies.
MBA ROI is strong for top performers, given the high placement ceiling.
ROI largely depends on internships, skills, and individual performance.

subject_lists.title: Mount Carmel College Campus & Facilities
subjects: Campus Overview: Beautiful, green, and vibrant campus in the heart of Bengaluru (Palace Road, Vasanth Nagar).
Library: Central Library with over 1 lakh books, journals, and e-resources (digital access too).
Auditoriums: 3 modern auditoriums with large seating and top-class sound systems (great acoustics).
Sports & Fitness Facilities: Wide range: Basketball court, football ground, billiards table, aerobics centre, and more.
Laboratories: State-of-the-art labs for science, computer, biotech, psychology, and other departments.
Cafeteria & Food Options: Popular campus canteen with lots of choices: fresh juices, ice creams, healthy bowls, snacks, and meals.
Hostel: On-campus hostel (Mother Mary Memorial Hostel) available (limited seats).

subject_lists.title: Mount Carmel College Campus & Facilities
subjects: Chapel: Peaceful space for reflection, ethics, and faith (core to the college's values).
ICT & Tech: Modern classrooms, Wi-Fi, smart tools, and digital learning support.
Green Initiatives: Eco-friendly campus with plants and sustainability efforts.

subject_lists.title: Mount Carmel College vs Christ University
subjects: Mount Carmel College is more affordable for B.Sc. students, with fees ranging from INR 1.42 Lakhs to INR 4.35 Lakhs.
Christ University has higher fees (INR 3 Lakhs – INR 7 Lakhs) but offers stronger placement outcomes.
Mount Carmel College provides core science specialisations like Biotechnology, Microbiology, Chemistry, and Zoology.
Christ University offers modern interdisciplinary options such as Data Science, Psychology, and Biotechnology.
The average package at Mount Carmel College is INR 3 LPA, while Christ University offers a higher average package of INR 6 LPA.
Students looking for affordability may prefer Mount Carmel College, while those prioritising placements and advanced specialisations may choose Christ University.

Ques. Is Mount Carmel College fully co-ed now?

Ans. Mount Carmel College was originally a women’s college, but now it offers co-ed programs mainly at the postgraduate level and in a few professional courses. Most undergraduate programs are still primarily for women, so the campus is still largely female-dominant.
Ques. Is attendance and discipline very strict at Mount Carmel College, Bangalore?

Ans. From what many seniors share, attendance at Mount Carmel College is taken quite seriously. Regular class participation is expected, and students who frequently miss lectures may find that it affects their internal assessments or practical marks. However, the level of strictness can vary slightly across departments and professors. That said, students who actively participate in college activities such as fests, clubs, competitions, or departmental events often mention that professors tend to be understanding, provided they communicate in advance. Maintaining reasonable attendance and staying responsible with academic commitments usually helps avoid any issues.
Ques. Are hostel seats limited at Mount Carmel College, Bangalore?

Ans. Yes, hostel accommodation at Mount Carmel College is limited. Because many students apply from outside Bangalore, the available hostel rooms usually fill up quickly after admissions begin. Students who need on-campus accommodation are generally advised to apply for the hostel as early as possible after confirming their admission to improve their chances of getting a seat.
Ques. How good is the crowd at Mount Carmel? Is it very competitive?

Ans. As per students and peers, the crowd is quite diverse. There are people from Bangalore, other states, and sometimes even international students. Academically strong students are definitely there, but the competition usually becomes noticeable during internships, leadership roles in clubs, or when preparing for higher studies. Many seniors say the environment pushes people to become more confident and independent.

Ques. Is Mount Carmel College fully co-ed now?

Ans. Mount Carmel College was originally a women’s college, but now it offers co-ed programs mainly at the postgraduate level and in a few professional courses. Most undergraduate programs are still primarily for women, so the campus is still largely female-dominant.
Ques. Is attendance and discipline very strict at Mount Carmel College, Bangalore?

Ans. From what many seniors share, attendance at Mount Carmel College is taken quite seriously. Regular class participation is expected, and students who frequently miss lectures may find that it affects their internal assessments or practical marks. However, the level of strictness can vary slightly across departments and professors. That said, students who actively participate in college activities such as fests, clubs, competitions, or departmental events often mention that professors tend to be understanding, provided they communicate in advance. Maintaining reasonable attendance and staying responsible with academic commitments usually helps avoid any issues.
Ques. Are hostel seats limited at Mount Carmel College, Bangalore?

Ans. Yes, hostel accommodation at Mount Carmel College is limited. Because many students apply from outside Bangalore, the available hostel rooms usually fill up quickly after admissions begin. Students who need on-campus accommodation are generally advised to apply for the hostel as early as possible after confirming their admission to improve their chances of getting a seat.
Ques. How good is the crowd at Mount Carmel? Is it very competitive?

Ans. As per students and peers, the crowd is quite diverse. There are people from Bangalore, other states, and sometimes even international students. Academically strong students are definitely there, but the competition usually becomes noticeable during internships, leadership roles in clubs, or when preparing for higher studies. Many seniors say the environment pushes people to become more confident and independent.

Ques. Is it compulsory to stay in hostel in LBSIM?

Ans. No, staying in the hostel at LBSIM Delhi is not compulsory. The institute offers hostel accommodation on a first-come, first-serve basis, and both Delhi-based and outstation students can choose whether or not they want to avail it. Many students opt for off-campus housing or commute from their homes, depending on convenience.

Ans. The Immersion Programs at LBSIM Delhi are designed to take learning beyond textbooks and help students experience the real world firsthand. They allow students to step into practical business, social, and leadership environments, giving them a deeper understanding of challenges and opportunities outside the classroom. Ques. Is the Final Research Project mandatory for all MBA students at LBSIM Delhi?

Ans. Yes, the Final Research Project (FRP) is mandatory for all MBA students at LBSIM Delhi. It forms an essential part of the curriculum and requires students to conduct research on a chosen management topic under the guidance of a faculty mentor. The FRP is evaluated through a written report and, in most cases, a presentation or viva, contributing to the student’s final academic assessment.

Ques. Can I get direct admission to LBSIM Delhi?

Ans. No, LBSIM Delhi does not offer direct admission to its MBA/PGDM programs. The institute follows a strictly merit-based selection process, where candidates must apply with a valid CAT, XAT, or GMAT score. Shortlisting is done on the basis of entrance exam performance, academic background, and work experience, followed by mandatory rounds of Extempore, Group Discussion, and Personal Interview. Since there is no management quota or donation-based entry, candidates must go through the complete selection process to secure admission.
Ques. Does LBSIM accept CMAT?

Ans. No, Lal Bahadur Shastri Institute of Management, Delhi does not accept CMAT score. LBSIM accepts score from other exams, such as the CAT, XAT, and GMAT. After submitting the score, candidates will be shortlisted for the next stages, which includes a Group Discussion, Extempore and a Personal Interview.
Ques. What is the OLT (Online Live Test) conducted by LBSIM during the MBA admission process?

Ans. The OLT (Online Live Test) conducted by LBSIM Delhi is an online assessment designed to evaluate a candidate’s aptitude, analytical ability, communication skills, and overall suitability for the MBA program. It is typically administered as part of the initial screening or along with the GD/PI rounds. The test may include components such as logical reasoning, verbal ability, situational judgment, and short written responses. The OLT helps LBSIM assess how candidates perform in a real-time, monitored environment, ensuring fairness and authenticity in the selection process. It also allows the institute to gauge a candidate’s clarity of thought, problem-solving capabilities, and readiness for the rigors of a management program.
Ques. What is the last date to apply for LBSIM 2026?

Ans. The last date to apply for the Lal Bahadur Shastri Institute of Management Delhi for the 2026-28 session is December 15, 2025. Candidates must submit the online application by this date to be considered for the MBA program.

12 May, 2026 UPTAC 2026 Counselling to begin soon. The registrations are expected to start in the first week of June 2026. Read news!

Institute of Engineering and Technology, Lucknow (IET Lucknow) is a Public institution established in 1984. It is affiliated with AKTU. According to Collegedunia rankings 2025, IET has been ranked 207th in the B.Tech category and 91st for its B.Tech program by the IIRF rankings 2025.

IET Lucknow recorded strong placement outcomes with about 70% UG placements, an average package of around INR 8.2 LPA, and a highest on-campus package of INR 49 LPA. Top recruiters included Google, Microsoft, and Goldman Sachs, with over 380 students placed by 50+ companies during the 2024–2025 placement season.
IET Lucknow offers admission to BTech programs based on the scores of JEE Main or CUET UG exam, whereas the admissions to the MTech or MBA programs are based on the CUET-PG or valid GATE scores.
The B.Tech admissions are conducted through JEE Main, and as per the schedule, the JEE Main 2026 exam session 2 is expected to begin in April 2026.
The UPTAC Counselling Schedule 2026 will be released course-wise on the official website – uptac.admissions.nic.in. Candidates can check the tentative counselling dates below:

Babu Banarasi Das Northern India Institute of Technology, also known as BBDNIIT, was established in 1999 in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. The college was formerly known as Northern India Engineering College. This institute has been recognised by AICTE and is affiliated with Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. The college has been accredited by NAAC with a grade A++.

BBDNIIT offers UG and PG courses like B.Tech, M.Tech, B.Pharm, M.Pharm, D.Pharm, and MBA. Among which, B.Tech is the flagship course offered by this institute. To get admission in the B.Tech course, students should have qualified 10+2 with 45% marks and have a valid score in UPTAC/JEE Mains. The course fee for B.Tech is INR 1.06 Lakhs for the first year.

BBDNIIT offers placement to the students. Since its establishment, almost 2000+ companies have visited the college, and 15,000 students have received scholarships. The placement data for 2025 has not been published yet. According to 2023 data, the highest offered package was INR 9 LPA, and the average offered package was INR 6.81 LPA. Top hiring companies are HCL, Tech Mahindra, Hexaware, L&T, Gemini Solutions, Coforge, FIS Global, Virtusa, NCR Corporation, Sopra Steria, JP Morgan Chase, Calvin Klein, ICICI Bank, Vodafone Idea, Cvent, Ernst & Young, Zomato, and many more.

The Birla Institute of Management Technology (BIMTECH), Greater Noida, offers a vibrant, green, and fully-equipped residential campus that creates an ideal environment for both academic learning and holistic development.
Ques. Does BIMTECH offer hostel facilities?

Ans. BIMTECH offers fully residential hostel facilities with spacious, centrally air-conditioned rooms for both boys and girls. Each cluster has a common area with a fridge and TV, and every floor has a microwave and RO water purifier to cater to students' needs.
Ques. Are there any cultural or recreational spaces at BIMTECH?

Ans. BIMTECH campus includes several recreational spaces like the music hut for musical practice, activity plaza for events, and machans for students to relax or work on group projects. The central lawn and swings across the campus add to the overall experience.
Ques. What are the placements like at BIMTECH?

Ans. BIMTECH achieved 95-100% placement for the 2024 batch across PGDM programs with over 130 recruiters. The highest International package stood at INR 24.43 LPA, while the average was INR 11.10 LPA. Top sectors included BFSI, IT/ITES, Consulting, Analytics, and Retail.
Ques. Does BIMTECH offer scholarships?

Ans. BIMTECH offers different scholarships ranging from INR 25,000 to INR 1,00,000 based on specific eligibility criteria. These include awards for academic toppers each term, female toppers, best Ph.D. thesis, and a special scholarship for female doctoral students from developing countries. Scholarships are also awarded in the form of gold and silver medals based on course-wise and specialization-wise performance.
Ques. What is the admission process for PGDM programs at BIMTECH?

Ans. Candidates can directly apply to PGDM programs at BIMTECH through the official website by filling out the online application form. Admission is based on valid scores in CAT, XAT, GMAT, CMAT, or MAT, along with performance in Personal Interview, academic profile, work experience, and other parameters.

BIMTECH, specifically the PGDM program, has a curriculum that blends theoretical and practical knowledge, which I found very beneficial. The faculty is quite experienced, and they use a case study approach, which helps in understanding real-world business scenarios. The exams are held every three months, and I found them to be moderately challenging.

Moreover, the college has a good placement record, with 100% of my batch getting placed this year, and the average package is around 11 lakhs. The internship opportunities are decent too; companies like KPMG and EY visit for internships, offering stipends that range broadly. Overall, my experience here has been quite positive.

The CAT cut-off for PGDM and PGDM-IB courses at BIMTECH Greater Noida was 70 percentile this year. The total cost, including hostel and mess fees, is over 14 lakhs, but it's best to check their website for the most accurate info. They also offer courses in Retail Management and Insurance Business Management, which have lower cut-offs than 70 percentile. These programs cost about 12 lakhs. Besides your personal expenses, there's not much additional spending. The school organizes a one-week industrial trip during the first year. For this, they cover half the costs, and students pay the rest.

Campus life: The 'Life at BIMTECH' section on their website has a link that shows different student-run activities you can join. I recommend checking out the 'Student Corner' under 'Life at BIMTECH' for more details. The campus has separate hostels for boys and girls, and there are dress codes to follow. Whether these rules fit your style or not is up to you. But don't worry too much about it, as students from 22 Indian states have been enrolling here for 28 years. Personally, I participated in several extracurricular activities and found the support from the Director and faculty to be quite solid. Many of my friends have great memories from these clubs, which helped them form lasting friendships.

Placements: BIMTECH offers plenty of placement opportunities across diverse industries every year. They also have lateral hiring, meaning students can secure positions above Assistant Manager or Manager after their Management Trainee period. As college representatives, students get to visit companies and interact with recruiters. The faculty provides invaluable support during placement season, helping with CVs, conducting mock interviews, and sharing experiences. They even connect students with alumni to discuss company-specific insights. The relationship between students and professors extends beyond academics and is truly valuable.

For details like placement rates, number of companies, and salary figures, the website and the Corporate Communications and Relations Team are transparent. A good tip is to reach out to BIMTECH alumni in your area, visit the CCR office, and check the alumni list online. This should clear up many questions about the institute's standing.

BIMTECH is a well-known and sought-after college for Management studies in the Delhi NCR area. It's especially recognized for its International Business Management program. The college boasts a strong alumni network, excellent facilities, and a dedicated group of professors for the Insurance and Business Management program. This course includes traditional insurance topics and industry-focused subjects. It also offers joint certifications with international education partners, like a Reinsurance certificate with Swiss Re and a Risk Management certificate with the Risk Insurance Management Society-USA. Experienced teachers have crafted the course to meet market needs with a balanced evaluation system.
BIMTECH Noida is a reputable business school in India. It offers PGDM courses in different specializations. It is a premier institution in India and provides a beneficial educational environment.

According to the NIRF report 2023, BIMTECH Noida has ranked 48 among all top business schools in India. It proves its educational excellence, academic facilities, and infrastructure. Back in the year 2020, BIMTECH bagged the status of category 1 autonomy status from AICTE.
All four of BIMTECH's postgraduate programs—PGDM, PGDM (IB), PGDM (RM), and PGDM (IBM)—have NBA accreditation, and NAAC renewal is in process.

It has a good faculty and alumni base which can be valuable for networking and career advancement. Mr. Munish Seth (Country Director, Android Partnerships, Google), Mr. Lokesh Mehra (Senior Business Lead – Learner Engagement, South Asia, Amazon Web Series) and many more eminent personalities are the distinguished alumni of this organization.
In conclusion, BIMTECH Noida is undeniably a commendable institution that continues to excel in its pursuit of academic excellence and professional development.

BIMTECH is recognized among India's top B-Schools by several publications. The program's rigorous curriculum, industry focus, and experiential learning are well-known. Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, Business Analytics, and International Business are BIMTECH MBA specializations. Dual specialization allows students to specialize in two management areas.

Placements for the institute are fine. Gartner, Accenture, Infosys, Maruti Suzuki, and Amazon recruit 1-2 students during final-year placements. Students have many internship and placement options at prominent companies due to the institute's strong industry connections.

subjects: JEE Main Scholarships: Based on scores availed in Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main, BTech aspirants applying to JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) - Faculty of Engineering and Technology shall be eligible for the grant of the meritorious scholarships. Ques. Can I pay fees in installment in St. Stephen’s College or the full amount required?

Ans. Normally, fees need to be paid in full at the time of admission to confirm a seat. College not usually allow installment option for admission fees. Students should check the college office or website for any support options if facing a financial problem before the admission process.
Ques. Do I get a refund if I cancel admission to St. Stephen’s College after fee payment?

But if a delay happens, the refund amount becomes less. So students should cancel admission quickly if not interested, otherwise, money loss can happen. Always check the latest DU refund rules before taking decision.

Ques. Is attendance very strict in St. Stephen’s College for regular classes?

Ans. Yes, attendance is quite strict in this college. Teachers expect students to attend classes regularly. If attendance is low, students can face problems with internal marks or exams. Ques. Can I do a part-time job while studying at St. Stephen’s College?

Ques. Is it easy to join societies in St. Stephen’s College for first-year students?

Ans. Not very easy because societies are competitive. Students have to give auditions or interviews to join. Some societies take only limited members. But if students try properly and show skills, they can join. It is good to participate because societies help in personality development and exposure.
Ques. Do students get a scholarship in St. Stephen’s College for financial support?

Ans. Yes college provide some scholarships and financial help for needy students. There are different funds and support systems available. Students have to apply with proper documents. Not all students get it, but deserving students can benefit. It helps in reducing the financial burden for studies.
Ques. Is the North Campus location helpful for students in St. Stephen’s College?

Ans. Yes location is very good because it is in the North Campus of Delhi University. Many colleges, cafes, libraries and coaching places are nearby. Students get good exposure and an environment. It also helps in networking and internships. The area is student-friendly and always active with college life.

National Insurance Academy (NIA), Pune, was established in 1980. NIA Pune offers the AICTE-approved PGDM course, which is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA) and granted equivalence to an MBA by AIU. In October 2023, NIA entered into an MOU with the African College of Insurance and Social Protection (ACISP), Tanzania, intending to establish a world-class modern facility to serve Africa in the fields of Insurance, Social Protection and allied fields. NIA, Pune received “Best Insurance Academy in India - Excellence Award For Training & Education In India” at Insurance & Fintech Summit, 2023.

Admission to the PGDM course will be based on the marks secured in CAT 2025/ CMAT 2026/ XAT 2026 and past academic records. The selection process will also include a Group Discussion and a Personal Interview, as well as a test of Knowledge of written English. The most popular course at NIA Pune is PGDM, with a total fee of INR 12 Lakhs.

NIA has a 100% placement record from the First Batch of 2010-12. The highest package offered to the students of batch 2023-25 was INR 20 LPA, and the Average package offered was INR 12.74 LPA. ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company, Tata AIG General Insurance Company, Aditya Birla Insurance Brokers, Swiss Re, Atos Syntel, and Reliance Industries Limited are some of the recruiters that visited the campus during the last placement season. The Alumni are working with reputed Multinational and Indian Reinsurance, Insurance Companies, Insurance Brokers, leading IT Companies & other industries both in India and abroad.

The PGDM program provided by NIA Pune matches the international standard, and the National Insurance Academy School of Management (NIASoM) has undergone complete syllabus restructuring under the supervision of Dr Prathap Oburai, the Director of INA.
NIA Pune offers admission to PGDM through CAT 2025 or XAT 2026, or CMAT 2026 entrance exams.

National Insurance Academy Pune offers one course at the postgraduate level. NIA Pune course includes a Postgraduate Diploma in Management. National Insurance Academy Pune PGDM include 55% management subjects and 45% insurance subjects. NIA Pune offers 180 seats annually for students. Details of the course and Fees are given below:

NIA Pune Admission 2026 for PGDM is through CAT 2025 or XAT 2026, or CMAT 2026 entrance exam scores. Candidates have to apply for admission by March 15, 2026. Applicants will be shortlisted based on eligibility, entrance exam scores, and academic record. Shortlisted candidates will undergo a Group Discussion (GD) and a Personal Interview (PI).

National Insurance Academy Pune's highest package is Rs 20 lakh per annum, while NIA's average salary package is Rs 12.75 lakh per annum. As per Sanskruti’s Review placement of NIA Pune is Great. The institute endeavours to help deserving candidates from different categories in pursuing management studies. NIA gives 9 scholarships of INR 1 lakh each to meritorious students, girl students and eligible students belonging to specified categories, including students belonging to economically weaker sections.

National Insurance Academy is spread over a 32-acre campus in the city of Pune on the Mumbai-Bengaluru highway, with greenery all around, providing an unmatched ambience along with high safety and security for the students. The institute has 10 Air-Conditioned lecture halls equipped with state-of-the-art facilities. Six of these classrooms are dedicated to PGDM Students. In addition, there are 8 syndicate rooms to facilitate group discussions, case studies, presentations and deliberations. Separate reading rooms are also available for the use of the students. Some other facilities of NIA Pune are listed below:
Convention Centre: NIA has a best-in-class auditorium with a seating capacity of 220, with an excellent audiovisual system.

Library: The institute has one of the few libraries in India having the choicest collection of books in life Insurance, non-life insurance and management areas. The reading room of this library is equipped with almost all national and international journals in Insurance, Actuarial Science, Pensions and related areas, including journals for general awareness and entertainment. A variety of research publications add further value to this already rich knowledge bank.

Computer Facilities: NIA has a Windows-based LAN, connected to State-of-the-art terminals spread all over the establishment. The Academy has an IT park classroom for IT training. Wi-Fi facility is available on the campus.

Insurance Labs: The academy fosters a unique concept known as Insurance Labs. There are a motor lab, marine lab and health lab for the students to get practical knowledge on related general insurance subjects.

Hostel: The student’s hostel “Sarvapalli” has fully furnished, spacious rooms. The hostels are separate for male and female students. It has 24 hours of uninterrupted power and water supply. Round-the-clock security is provided in the hostel and the rest of the campus. There is also an Internet facility with Wi-Fi connectivity for the students in the rooms. No Hostel allotment to Pune-based students.

Grievance Redressal Committee & Anti-Ragging Committee: The Academy is fully compliant with the regulations about “Establishment of Mechanism for Grievance Redressal Regulations, 2012 of AICTE & the Internal Complaint Committee. NIA follows anti-ragging regulations as per AICTE norms.

Health Care: There is a clinic where a doctor visits regularly and is also available on call. In addition, students have the benefit of Mediclaim and personal accident cover up to a specified amount under a group policy during the duration of the course.

Sports and Recreation: The multipurpose sporting complex has facilities for badminton, table tennis, billiards, a state-of-the-art gymnasium, sauna, Jacuzzi. There is a swimming pool in the sports complex. There is also an open ground for playing cricket, football and basketball.
Yoga & Meditation Hall: The institute has a separate Yoga and Meditation Centre on campus for the students.

Jogging Track and GIC Pathway: The 1.5 km jogging track encircling the campus is a wonderful way to breathe fresh air and hear the chirping of the birds. The GIC Pathway, close to the sporting complex, is a water-fed pathway with gravel
for acupressure therapy.

Banking and Postal Services: A branch of Bank of Maharashtra and a Post Office are located near the main gate of the campus for banking (Forex services also available) and postal needs, including an ATM facility.

The officials, including faculty working at NIA, live on the campus. Many festivals are celebrated with enthusiasm by the families of campus residents, including children, where the students also participate wholeheartedly. All cultural programmes involve all the residents of the campus, students & MDP participants.
Ques. What is the profile provided by NIA through its PGDM course?

Ans. Being a joint venture of the top Insurance PSUs of the country, NIA has the potential to give exceptional exposure to its students. The course is similar to other PGDM courses but with a specialisation in Insurance subjects. Top Insurance companies come every year as recruiters here and offer a post of Administrative Officer to selected students.
Ques. Does NIA give opportunities for a Summer Internship to its students?
Ans. Yes, NIA provides Summer Internship opportunities to its students. Various companies come to the college to recruit for summer internship programmes as well.
Ques. How is the Faculty of NIA Pune?

Ans. NIA Pune has an exceptional faculty list. Being directly affiliated with the Ministry of Finance, students get a chance to come in touch with experienced leaders of the Insurance industry. The faculty comprises academicians and practitioners who are on the NIA campus on a full-time basis, in addition to regular visiting faculty.
Ques. Is NIA Pune internationally affiliated?
Ans. Yes, NIA has international affiliations with organisations like The Institute (USA), the Canadian Institute of Insurance, and CII (London).
Ques. What are the placement statistics of NIA Pune?
Ans. NIA Pune boasts a 100% placement record. The highest package offered by NIA Pune in the current year was 20 LPA.
Ques. Is a loan facility available for pursuing courses at NIA Pune?
Ans. Yes, Education loans are available from leading Public Sector and Private Banks under the Premier Institution Scheme.
Ques. Why should I join NIA Pune for its PGDM program?

Ans. The PGDM programme at National Insurance Academy has a unique blend of Management and Insurance subjects where emphasis is placed both on theory and practice. Students of NIA, on completion of PGDM, have an exemption from the Associateship examination conducted by the Insurance Institute of India based on specific criteria. This gives them an edge over others in gaining insurance knowledge and good placement through campus selection.

NIA has excellent infrastructure facilities for curricular, Co-curricular and extracurricular activities that include a library stocking over 25000 books and around 4000 + holdings and online journals on management and insurance.

The PGDM programme of NIA provides the students a practical exposure and the opportunity to interact with Regulators, CEOs of Insurance Companies and other Professional Bodies by involving them in several interactive Seminars, Conferences and Insurance Summits throughout the 2-year course.

The institute's strong industry connections and rigorous academic curriculum prepare students for success in the rapidly evolving tech landscape.
Ques. What are the eligibility criteria for admission to SICSR Pune?

Ans. Eligibility criteria vary based on the program you're applying for. Generally, for undergraduate programs, candidates must have completed their 10+2 education, while for postgraduate programs, a bachelor's degree in a relevant field is required.
Ques. What is SET 2025?

Ques. Is the SNAP test compulsory for admission in SICSR?

Ans. Ques. I have received the SNAP ID & Password, what can I use them for?

Ans. You can use the SNAP ID/ email and password to fill in the SNAP application form, view/ print the admit card, check My Mail, and modify personal details. If you apply to institutes which take SNAP scores, you should use your SNAP ID.

V.L.B. Janakiammal College of Arts and Science (VLBJCAS) is a private institution that was founded in 1991. It is situated in Kovaipudur, Coimbatore, in Tamil Nadu, a nd it is a Bharthiar University, Coimbatore affiliate, and it is awarded a grade B++ by NAAC. It is approved by the AICTE.

VLBJCAS offers a range of courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate, and Doctoral levels. Among which BSc is its flagship course, and the first-year fees for BSc are between INR 15,000 and INR 30,000, based on the specialisations. The admissions in the institute are based on the marks obtained in the entrance examination. To take admission in the MBA program, the candidates have to clear the TANCET entrance exam.

VLBJCAS Placement 2025 reports have not been released yet. However, according to our research, the highest package offered is INR 7 LPA, and the average package is INR 2.4 LPA, with a placement percentage of 70-80%. The top recruiters are AEE BEE Academy, Amazon Development Centre, ATMECS Technologies Pvt. Ltd, Bright Star Educational Institution, Concentrix, CTS, Digital Nirvana Information Pvt. Ltd, English Edge, IDBI Federal Life Insurance Corporation Pvt. Ltd, Info Test Lab, Infosys, KGISL, Photorooster, Studios LLP, RNDSOFT, TCS.

UG: BSc, B.Com, BBA, BCA.
PG: MBA, MCA, MSc, M.Phil, and PhD.

The VLBJCAS Admission 2025 has been announced. VLBJCAS has 20 undergraduate, 5 postgraduate, and 5 research programmes, and some diploma and certificate courses. The opportunities for research are found in fields of Tamil, Mathematics, Commerce, Computer Science, Library and Information Science, and Management. TANCET scores are necessary to be valid for admission to MBA and MCA, and selections are made through a centralised counselling process. Since it is an institution of merit-based education, it offers admission according to the merit of its applicants, eligibility, and entrance examination, where necessary.
The VLBJCAS offers many UG, PG, and doctoral courses. The first-year fees for these courses are between INR 10,000 to INR 45,000. The table below shows the VLBJCAS courses and fees for 2025:

Ltd, English Edge, IDBI Federal Life Insurance Corporation Pvt. Ltd, Info Test Lab, Infosys, KGISL, Photorooster, Studios LLP, RNDSOFT, TCS.

Library: VLBJCAS Library has an area of 5,340 sq. ft. and can accommodate 150 readers. The library has more than 38,519 books in different subjects, including Indian and foreign. It is subscribing to 200 periodicals, including 95 peer-reviewed journals. Besides, a separate PG Library comes to the aid of postgraduate students, including 11,979 books, 46 periodicals and 32 national journals, 14 international periodicals, which provides a healthy academic resource background.

Laboratories: To sharpen the practical skills of its students, VLBJCAS has some of the best modern facilities, such as 7 Computer Labs, 2 Electronics Labs, 5 Costume and Fashion Design Labs, 3 Visual Communication Labs, and 5 Catering and Hotel Management Labs. The university has an extensive network system that sectors on IBM and Dell servers that operate multiple operating systems. The newest software, hardware, and the entire labs are provided with the latest audio-visual aids to enhance the learning process of the students.

Cafeteria: VLBJCAS offers various food items that are healthy, nutritious, and delicious in its canteen on the campus. It provides breakfast, lunch, and snacks, soft drinks at very reasonable prices to the students and also the faculty members.

Auditorium: VLBJCAS has a well-ventilated, large auditorium with professional acoustics and about 2,000 sitting capacity. The college also has well-furnished conference and Seminar halls that are fitted with modern projectors and sound systems, with all the halls being fully air conditioned, and they are convenient to host a host of academic events, official meetings, and also cultural programs.

Transport: Transport facilities are also available in VLBJCAS, and convenient travel of the students and the faculty to various parts of Coimbatore and also Kerala to the different corners is ensured by a fleet of buses. The students and the staff also have partitioned and well-organised parking arrangements on the campus, including the students' and staff's two-wheelers as well as four-wheelers.
Sports: VLBJCAS has laid stress on physical education, games, and sporting activities that have ensured all-around growth of students along with academics.

VLBJCAS provides hostel facilities to outstation students with a well-defined, spacious, homely ambience and clean food being served in a well-maintained mess. Boys and girls sections are isolated in separate hostels, surrounded by green and with an open-air feeling. There is also free Wi-Fi available to all the residents of the hostel, and this facility helps in both comfort and academic necessity. According to our research, the hostel fees are INR 65,000.

Ques. How to apply for VLBJCAS admission 2025?
Ans. The college offers an online application system through which the candidate will pay the application fee, fill out the online application form, and attach the required documents.

As a BCA student at IMS, you will have the opportunity to choose a specialization field in which you want to gain expertise. The Institute offers five areas of specialization: Cyber Security & Real-World Computing, Android & Web Based Computing, Data Analytics, Internet of Things, and Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence. Each of these diploma courses is spread over four semesters, and in the third semester, you will choose one of the three offered courses. In the sixth semester, you will select one option from a basket of super specializations.

IMS' dedicated CDC Team provides career counseling based on scientific psychometric profiling to help you choose a specialization that aligns with your personality and skill set. The Institute also organizes a sensitization program where corporate experts from various domains discuss recent trends, scope, and the global outlook of each specialization.

If you have a strong analytical background and an interest in data and statistics, then you may want to consider the Data Analytics specialization. This specialization focuses on using metrics to analyze a business's past performance, gain valuable insights, and plan for the future. The curriculum covers all aspects of analytics, including Descriptive, Prescriptive, Diagnostic, and Predictive, and utilizes tools and techniques like a computer simulation, predictive modeling, data mining, and artificial intelligence. You will work with technologies such as Python and machine learning, and develop a comprehensive understanding of the dynamic market trends and their practical applications in the industry.

If you are interested in a field that is growing in demand, consider Cyber Security with Real-World Computing. Cyber threats are becoming increasingly prevalent, making cybersecurity professionals a valuable commodity. This specialization provides a comprehensive understanding of computer security, including network security, cloud security, application security, and system infrastructure. You will gain hands-on experience with live projects and workshops, and develop the technical knowledge and skills to become a forward-thinking IT professional.

If you are obsessed with mobile and web development, consider Android & Web Based Computing. With billions of people around the world using handheld devices and accessing a wealth of information, this specialization is essential in today's technological era. You will learn a range of topics, including website creation, mobile applications, Core Java, SQL, and more. The curriculum is constantly updated to reflect the latest technological developments, and students are given opportunities to hone their skills through workshops and activities. The goal is to produce technically sound IT professionals who can contribute to the growth of technology and make their own niche in the industry.

Finally, if you are innovative and interested in the connected world of the Internet of Things, consider the Internet of Things with a Machine Learning specialization. This diploma course aims to identify budding technocrats with the potential to envision an automated future. You will gain a deep understanding of various concepts and languages, including Python, Node JS, and Data Analytics. The goal is to produce tech-savvy individuals with a strong foundation in IOT and machine learning who can lead the way in this field.

Honestly, joining the Welingkar Institute of Management for the Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) has been a transformative experience for me. The curriculum is well-structured and covers a mix of theoretical and practical learning, which is great for understanding real-world applications. The faculty is also quite experienced, which adds a lot of value.

However, the fee is on the higher side at around 14 lakhs for the entire program, and while the placement opportunities are decent with an average package around 12 lakhs, not everyone gets placed easily. If you’re considering resigning from your job, it might be worth it if you're really passionate about advancing your career in management.
As someone who was part of Welingkar's PGDM program (2013 batch), I can share my insights about the institute. Let's go over some pros and cons and what you can expect overall.

If you're aiming for a solid business school, there are a few essentials you should look for: exposure, internships and placements, infrastructure (like buildings and tech), courses, faculty, reputation, the balance between tuition and salary, alumni network, rankings, and other facilities.
Welingkar follows a trimester system, splitting their PGDM courses into six trimesters over two years.

Gaining exposure is crucial for any MBA student. As an aspiring manager, you need an environment that challenges your thinking. You'll meet a diverse group of students with different backgrounds and ideas. Both your peers and professors will push you intellectually. The competitive atmosphere will encourage you to step out of your comfort zone and improve.

Welingkar offers an excellent outbound program shortly after you join, which involves fun and educational activities outside the city. It's a pity more colleges don't offer this kind of experience. The college also hosts guest lectures from industry leaders, providing valuable insights into the corporate world. There are also programs to help you develop soft skills, which are essential for standing out as a management graduate. If you take these seriously, you'll see noticeable growth by the end of the program.
2. Internships & Final Placements

When choosing a b-school, internships and final placements are critical. Classroom learning is one thing, but practical experience is another. It's up to the college to provide enough opportunities for internships and job placements.

There are plenty of discussions online about the offers and packages students receive at Welingkar, both domestic and international, and I can confirm they're accurate. However, like many schools, Welingkar faces challenges in placing every student due to large batch sizes. Sometimes, opportunities don't match the number of students, and those who aren't placed early on might struggle to find quality placements later. This is common in many b-schools with large intakes.

During my time, several students had to secure internships or placements independently, either because they didn't get one through the campus or wanted to work in a specific field. Personally, I landed a great job through campus placements. If you apply yourself during those two years, you can find a good position. Ultimately, focus on nailing that one offer with a company you desire, as that's all you need.
3. Infrastructure (Physical + IT + Library)
Is infrastructure a big deal? Yes and no.
No, if you're not interested in anything beyond getting a job or if you're at a place like JBIMS, where infrastructure isn't a priority.

Yes, if you want to make the most of your investment in the college, participate in competitions, or need resources for case studies. Welingkar offers a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, study rooms, excellent IT facilities, a well-stocked library, and even a gym. There are numerous case studies available for analysis as well.
In terms of physical infrastructure, it often comes down to mindset. When the environment is well-maintained and lively, it can positively impact your mood and motivation...

Welingkar Institute of Management's Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) has a pretty comprehensive curriculum that balances theory and practical learning. The faculty is quite experienced and brings a lot of industry knowledge, which makes classes engaging. However, the internship opportunities could be better; I found that while many companies visit for placements, the ratio of students getting hired is not very encouraging. Overall, the college does prepare you well for the corporate world, but there's always room for improvement in terms of internships.

My experience in the PGDM (E Business) course at Welingkar has been quite enriching. The curriculum is designed to be practical, covering a wide range of topics from finance to marketing, and it’s updated regularly. I got an internship with a stipend of 75,000, which was a fantastic opportunity.

The placement process is thorough, and even though the college claims a good placement percentage, the reality can be a bit different with some students struggling to find roles. Overall, the college provides a solid foundation, but the workload is heavy, especially during the trimesters.

Honestly, I think joining the PGDM in E Business at Welingkar Institute of Management is a solid option. The curriculum is well-designed and covers a lot of relevant topics like AI, data analytics, and digital marketing. It's definitely preparing us for the corporate world.

Plus, many companies like Accenture and Morgan Stanley come for internships, and the stipends can be quite good, with some students getting as much as 80,000 per month. However, the fees are around 14 lakhs, which is quite steep. Still, the average package for placements is about 12 lakhs, so if you’re aiming for a good return on investment, it might be worth it.

WeSchool has a comprehensive and well-structured curriculum for the Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) that incorporates both theoretical and practical components. The faculty is highly qualified, offering relevant industry insights. However, the internships available can be quite competitive, with a hiring ratio of 1:10, which means not everyone gets placed.

The college sees visits from reputable companies like GEP and Morgan Stanley, but the final placements can be hit or miss. Overall, I feel WeSchool provides a good mix of academic rigor and industry exposure, albeit with some challenges in securing internships.
Thanks for asking. It's been 5 years since I graduated from Welingkar Bangalore and 7 years since I went through the GD PI process there, but I still remember it clearly.

The campus left a big impression on me. The Bangalore campus is like a design masterpiece. It's got everything you need but still looks simple and understated from the outside. It's perfect for those who love minimalist design.
For the Group Discussion, we were in one of the lecture rooms. The topic was pretty general, which makes sense since the group had people from different educational backgrounds.

The Interview was quite an experience. I was super nervous at first. The interviewers came from a design field, and I later learned that one of them was Mr. Kaustabh, known for his expertise in Strategy Design.

They started with the usual "Tell me about yourself" questions to help me relax, asking about my studies and interests. Then, they threw me a curveball: a piece of paper with a curvy line like an upside-down "S". They simply said, "Make something of it." I paused, turned it into a Yin-Yang, then into a balloon held by a stick-figure child.
They asked why I chose those symbols, and we ended up discussing design and my interests. Looking back, my ideas weren't groundbreaking, but I was honest and true to myself.

For the Creative Test, we had a single word to work with: "Elated". Using materials like charts, colors, and sparkles, we had to create an image. I drew India’s winning shot in the 2011 Cricket World Cup with Dhoni and cheering fans. I did my best, and it looked better than a preschooler's drawing.
The Aptitude Test was basic math and English questions on a computer, lasting about 30 minutes.

The fee for the program is around 14 lakhs, which can be paid in installments. When it comes to placements, the college claims to have a good record, but it can be tough to secure a position, especially with the high number of students. Companies like GEP and Infosys come for internships, but the average stipends can vary a lot.

Consider the financial aspect of pursuing an MBA, as the return on investment (ROI) is crucial. If you plan to take out a loan to finance your education, keep in mind that a significant portion of your salary may go toward paying off your debt. Additionally, the average salary package may include variable pay, meaning you may receive less money than expected.

Think about the turnaround time for completing your degree. Some institutions, such as GLIM, offer a one-year PGPM course, which means you can start earning and paying bills sooner than those who opt for a longer program. This can also give you a head start in terms of gaining work experience and building your bank balance.

Consider the brand value of the institution you choose to attend. While brand value is important, particularly when seeking employment, it may not hold as much weight in the long term. Ultimately, your achievements and experience will be more important than where you earned your degree.

Trident Academy of Technology Bhubaneswar , also known as TAT, is a private university established in 2005 in F2A, Chandaka Industrial Estate, Bhubaneswar, Odisha. TAT is approved by AICTE & Affiliated to Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Odisha .It is accredited by NAAC with Grade B+. It offers a variety of undergraduate(UG) and postgraduate(PG) courses in engineering, IT, and business management.

TAT offers admission to the B.Tech as its flagship program. It offers Computer Science & Engineering , Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Information Technology, Biotechnology. The overall tuition cost of the B.Tech course in Trident Academy of Technology (TAT), Bhubaneswar, is between INR 3.39 lakhs and INR 4.43 lakhs throughout the entire 4-year tenure, subject to the specialization opted.

Trident Academy of Technology Bhubaneswar has very competitive fee structures across UG and PG programs. The B.Tech (CSE, ETE, EEE, CST, CE, ME) program fee structure is INR 4.32 lakhs for 4 years, while lateral entry students pay 3 years of fee structure, INR 3.24 lakhs. The Postgraduate fees are INR 1.44 lakhs for M.Tech, INR 2.12 lakhs for MBA, INR 1.48 lakhs for MCA, and INR 1.08 lakhs for a 3 Years BBA program.

Trident Academy of Technology offers a range of technical and management courses with eligibility and entrance criteria that are quite specific and easy to follow. The eligibility to B.Tech is 10+2 with 45% marks and a valid JEE Main / OJEE score for entrance . M.Tech requires B.E./ B.Tech qualification and GATE or PGAT for entrance. The management programs MBA and MCA, require an entrance exam which can be OJEE / CAT/ CMAT, while BBA admission is based on 10+2 marks or an institutional test or interview.

The admission process at Trident Academy of Technology (TAT), Bhubaneswar is designed to be seamless and transparent. It starts with enquiry and counselling for eligible candidates, followed by application submission, entrance-based shortlisting, and final enrollment through document verification and fee payment. The step-wise procedure ensures that students are well-informed and properly inducted into their respective programs.

Campus Life: Trident Academy of Technology (TAT), Bhubaneswar has a complete Wi-Fi facility campus with digital classrooms and state-of-the-art labs. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled, providing students with uninterrupted internet connectivity to engage in online courses and access study material online.
Ques: When was Trident Academy of Technology established and what is its affiliation?

Ans. Trident Academy of Technology (TAT) was established in 2005 in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. It is a private engineering institute affiliated with the Biju Patnaik University of Technology (BPUT), Odisha. The institution is approved by the AICTE and also recognized by bodies like the DSIR and NAAC, making it one of the well-recognized colleges in the region for technical education.
Ques: Is Trident a government or private college?

Ans.Trident Academy of Technology is a private institution. While it operates under the guidelines of government-approved bodies like BPUT and AICTE, it is not funded or managed by the government. As a private autonomous institute, TAT has the flexibility to upgrade its curriculum, labs, and infrastructure to meet industry standards and student needs.
Ques: What are the courses offered at Trident and how can one take admission?

Ans. TAT offers undergraduate (B.Tech) and postgraduate programs (M.Tech, MBA, MCA). Popular B.Tech specializations include Computer Science Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, and Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning.

Admissions for B.Tech are primarily through JEE Main or OJEE counseling. For M.Tech and MBA programs, admissions are based on GATE, OJEE, or equivalent exam scores. A valid entrance test score, along with qualifying 10+2 or graduation criteria, is mandatory for eligibility.
Ques: What is the fee structure for different programs at TAT?

Ans. The fee structure at TAT is moderate compared to many private institutions. For B.Tech courses, the annual tuition fee ranges from INR89,000 to INR1,10,000, depending on the branch and year of admission. For MBA and MCA, the fees are typically between INR1.1 to INR1.5 Lakh per year, and M.Tech courses are around INR1 Lakh per year. In addition to tuition, students may need to pay hostel, examination, and university fees.
Ques: How are the placements at Trident Academy of Technology?

Ans. TAT has consistently maintained a decent placement record, especially in branches like CSE, ECE, and MBA. The highest package offered in recent years has reached up to INR10–12 LPA, while the average package lies between INR3.5 to INR4.5 LPA. Companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Capgemini, HCL, and IBM are regular recruiters at the campus. Pre-placement training, mock interviews, and coding classes are offered to prepare students for corporate challenges.
Ques: What is the placement percentage at TAT Bhubaneswar?

Ans. Placement percentage varies slightly by year and department. In core branches like CSE and ECE, around 80–90% of eligible students secure jobs. For non-IT branches like Civil and Mechanical, the percentage is lower, around 50–60%, though students often pursue higher studies or government sector jobs. The Training & Placement Cell is active and continues to build new industry linkages.
Ques: What are the eligibility criteria and cutoff for B.Tech at TAT?

Ans. Eligibility for B.Tech requires candidates to have passed 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science/Biology with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved categories). Cutoffs are declared through OJEE or JEE Main counseling, and they vary for each stream. For CSE, a good JEE rank (under 1.5 lakh AIR) can improve chances of admission, whereas for other branches, the cutoffs are comparatively lower.
Ques: How is the infrastructure and campus life at Trident?

Ans. TAT is known for its spacious 10-acre green campus, equipped with smart classrooms, modern laboratories, Wi-Fi-enabled hostels, and a large central library. The campus also includes auditoriums, sports facilities, and food courts. Beyond academics, the college encourages student clubs, technical fests, hackathons, and cultural events like Trifest and Genesis. Campus life is engaging and student-friendly.
Ques: Is hostel accommodation available at Trident Bhubaneswar? How are the facilities?

Ans. Yes, TAT provides separate hostels for boys and girls within the campus. Rooms are generally 2 or 3-sharing and come with basic furnishings, internet, and attached washrooms. The hostel mess serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, with a weekly menu. While many students are satisfied, some reviews mention scope for improvement in terms of hygiene and food quality. Regular wardens and security ensure a safe environment.
Ques: Does Trident offer any scholarships or financial aid?

Ans. TAT provides scholarships through state-level schemes like the Medhabruti Scholarship, E-Medhabruti, and Minority Scholarships for eligible students. Additionally, students with top ranks in OJEE or JEE Main may get fee waivers under the Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) scheme. Needy students may also apply for financial assistance through government programs and education loans tied up with banks.
Ques. Is Trident NAAC accredited and how is its academic ranking?

Ans. Yes, Trident Academy of Technology is NAAC accredited with a B+ Grade and approved by AICTE. While it may not appear in the top 50 of NIRF rankings nationally, it is considered one of the top private engineering colleges in Odisha. Continuous curriculum upgrades, industry tie-ups, and the presence of innovation labs have improved its academic standing in recent years.

Ques. What exactly happens in the Group Exercise (GE) during ASP at JAGSOM Bangalore?

Ans. In the group exercise, 6–8 candidates are given a real business case—like a fintech startup planning rural expansion or an FMCG brand handling a PR crisis. You get about 5 minutes to read, 20–25 minutes to discuss, and 5 minutes to present a group solution. The panel looks for clear thinking, good listening, teamwork, and practical ideas—not who talks the most.
Ques. When should I apply for the best chance and maximum scholarship at JAGSOM Bangalore?

Ans. Phase 1 applications close on 30 November 2025. Applying early offers three key advantages: faster shortlisting in December, a better chance of receiving a 30–50% merit scholarship, and more flexibility in choosing your preferred major before popular fields like Marketing or Analytics fill up.
Ques. Is work experience mandatory for MBA admission at JAGSOM Bangalore?

Ans. No, work experience is not mandatory. Freshers make up about 55–60% of each batch. However, having 6–36 months of relevant work experience can add approx. 5–12 marks to your profile score and significantly boosts your performance in the Group Exercise and PI.

Gandhi Institute of Technology and Management is a private college established in 2008. It is located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Gandhi Institute of Technology and Management is affiliated with Biju Pattnaik University of Technology. The institute is approved by AICTE, SCTE&VT, and AISHE. The institute has accreditation from the NBA and is certified by ISO. Gandhi Institute of Technology and Management's overall ranking by NIRF is 101-150 out of 200 colleges in India in 2024.

Gandhi Institute of Technology and Management offers UG, PG & Diploma courses. Among B.Tech is its flagship course, and the total fee for the B.Tech is INR 2.24 Lakhs for all specialisations, but it is different for the management quota. PES(People Education Society) and GITAM(Gandhi Institute of Technology and Management) is one of the oldest engineering colleges in India. These colleges outshine each other in all fields whether it is academics, placement, hostel facilities. According to NIRF ranking, 2020 GITAM and PES stands at 71st position and 149th rank respectively.

Both the colleges offer Undergraduate, Postgraduate and Doctorate courses. But, GITAM offers some additional courses like management and law. Here is some of the important information about the two institutes.

For admission into GITAM, students need to appear for the GAT exam for BTech, GSAT for Science, and GLAT for the law courses. Eligibility is 10+2 with 60% aggregate in science stream. The application fee is INR 800.
For admission into regular courses at PES University, students need to appear for the PESSAT/CET exam. Eligibility is 10+2 with 45% aggregate in the science stream. The application fee is INR 1050.
GITAM has a total of 2300 seats and PES has 1500 seats.

Both the colleges have experienced faculties guiding them during their course of study whether it is research and development, academics, placement activities. Most of them are Ph.D. holders and are working on many government-funded projects.
PES University is spread over a lush 25 acres, which include a central library, 24*7 medical center, cafeteria, hostels, and stationery shop.
GITAM has more than one campus and offers home-like space to its students whether it is a mess or well-ventilated hostel rooms. The hostel has a total of 2300 seats.
Both colleges have designed the fee structure according to students' academics and facilities provided. PES has a higher fee structure compared to GITAM.
BTech GITAM charges INR 2.42 lakh per year and PES INR 3.3 lakhs per year.

In the recent placement activity, a total of 300 companies visited GITAM for the drive. TCS was the major recruiter by choosing 755 engineering students. A total of 1921 students were selected from on-campus placement.
The highest package offered at PES University was INR 48 LPA, and the median salary was INR 7 LPA. More than 50 companies visited the colleges for the placement drive.

Scholarships for various categories are provided by both the universities. Students can choose any of the ones depending on their preferences. PES and GITAM are among the reputed colleges in India which is evident from its national rankings.

GLIM Gurgaon PGDM AWT-PI interview experience: At Great Lakes Gurgaon, the interview was held online on Zoom and was very well organized. The panel usually had two interviewers who were calm and friendly. The interview began with basic questions like ‘Tell me about yourself,’ followed by questions on education, achievements, work experience, and why you want to pursue an MBA. They also asked questions about current topics such as city issues and general awareness. The conversation was mostly natural, focusing on understanding my profile, goals, thinking ability, and communication skills. The panel also asked what other B-schools I was considering and gave helpful suggestions for making the most of the MBA journey.

I once visited the campus of Great Lakes Chennai and I knew right then that it was going to be my dream college. I also looked up at the Gurgaon campus and it was clearly visible how the infrastructure of the Chennai campus was way superior to that of the Gurgaon campus.

The Chennai campus is located away from the hustle and bustle of the city in a serene location around 60km from Chennai. This beautiful campus spreads across 27 acres and the tranquility can be felt by all nature lovers. I am attaching some pictures that will do justice to the beauty of this campus
Aerial view of the ground and the mess
The pictures alone cannot testify to the campus's beauty so it's recommended you visit it once.
Ultimately, both campuses offer equal opportunities and education the only difference lies in the infrastructure and quality of campus life.
Since its establishment, Great Lakes be it Chennai or Gurgaon has been delivering premium quality management education at par with recent industry trends.

As per the official rankings, Great Lales Chennai ranked 31st among management institutes by NIRF 2023 and 11th among private colleges by IIRF Ranking 2023. On the other hand, Great Lakes Gurgaon was ranked 62 out of 125 colleges by NIRF in India in 2023 and it was 52 out of 125 colleges in India in 2022.

However, these rankings are highly transparent and misleading. Either the ranking parameters are not credible or the institutes refuse to participate resulting in exaggerated figures. So it's best to talk to alumni to get a better picture and don’t just rely on rankings.

The average package offered to the top 10% of students during BIMTECH placements 2023 stood at INR 15.86 LPA whereas Students placed with Top 10% of the average package at Great Lakes Gurgaon was INR 14.40 LPA .so in terms of placement, BIMTECH PGDM core is better.

Since you have work experience an executive MBA program would better suit your career goals. Hence, you should go with the Great Lakes PGPM program. The placement figures are also better for the PGPM program at Great Lakes compared to TAPMI’s regular MBA program and the duration of the program is also lesser (1 year).

The executive MBA program of Great Lakes Institute of Management is one of their flagship programs. If you have two or more years of working experience, go for a GLIM executive MBA.

Many prominent recruiters like Accenture Strategy, which offers a package of around 32 LPA, and Tiger Analytics, which provides a package of 18 LPA visit the GLIM campus. If you have time to do a two-year MBA program and are fresher, then you can join SCMHRD MBA.

Taking a student loan is always a better option. After graduating from college, Education loans help you save taxes during the job career. Go through the interest percentage at which the loan will be disbursed and take calculated steps while taking a loan.
NMIMS Bangalore is better than Great Lakes Gurgaon PGPM, and Great Lakes’s Manipal campus is only better.

The other campuses at Great Lakes are still in the growing stage, so I would suggest you not to choose them. Instead, you can opt for NMIMS, the faculties there are experienced, and they have industry exposure as well, plus you have a location advantage. Many companies have their offices in Bangalore, so it would be easy for you to grab a placement there. NMIMS also has a great student culture from various clubs and committees you can groom yourself.

TAPMI is better, as it offers you a great campus life. The crowd is suitable to make connections and you can really groom yourself, plus TAPMI has a great culture of clubs and committees so that you can learn actual management skills.

TAPMI has very good faculties and their curriculum is also appropriate as per the industry requirement. The placements offered by TAPMI are better than the others, many big companies like Accenture, Deloitte, Ford, TATA visit the campus for placements.
SIBM Bangalore, TAPMI, and Great Lakes PGPM are top Indian business schools with distinct capabilities. Your job goals and choices determine it.

SIBM Bangalore has a robust curriculum, skilled instructors, and a focus on practical learning through case studies and industry interactions. Many top companies hire from the institute. Students have several internship and business engagement possibilities in Bangalore, a hub for top corporations.

TAPMI is a top business school with rigorous academics, skilled faculty, and excellent industry contacts. Many top companies hire from the institute. TAPMI is in Manipal, Karnataka, a university town that fosters study.

Great Lakes PGPM, is known for its academic curriculum, experienced professors, and creative programs. A unique 1-year program at the institute gives students the skills and knowledge they need to excel in the fast-changing corporate environment.

It's up to you to decide what kind of return on investment (ROI), brand value, and/or location/career convenience you need from your business school. TAPMI and Great Lakes provide comparable average packages (between 11 and 12 lakhs per year), but SIBM Bangalore's average is lower, at 9 to 10 lakhs. Great Lakes Chennai is the best option out of the three because it has the most appealing combination of affordable rates and a well-known name brand. When compared to SIBM Pune and Great Lakes, TAPMI and SIBM Bangalore both fall short.

Ques. Can candidates apply through more than one entrance exam score for MBA at XIME Bangalore?

Ques. Can candidates update their entrance exam scores after submitting the application at XIME Bangalore?

Xavier Institute of Management and Entrepreneurship (XIME) Bangalore is located in Electronics City, Bangalore. The campus is spread over about 4.3 acres of land. It has academic buildings, hostels, a library, and recreational facilities in one place.The academic block has classrooms with modern teaching equipment, seminar halls, and a 500-seat auditorium.
